programme.title: SpeakGaelic
programme.desc:
Tha Joy Dunlop gar toirt tron tuilleadh cheumannan airson ar misneachadh gus leantainn oirnn a bhith bruidhinn na Gàidhlig. Thairis air an t-sreath seo, bidh i a' dèiligeadh ri facail is abairtean air measgachadh de chuspairean co-cheangailte ri gach taobh de ar beatha. Leis gun do dh'ionnsaich i fhèin a' chànan, bheir Joy dhuinn briathrachas a tha sìmplidh agus furasta a thuigsinn. Bidh stiùireadh ann cuideachd a thaobh a bhith a' cleachdadh abairtean, le eisimpleirean soilleir tro chòmhraidhean goirid.
Coinnichidh sinn ri luchd-labhairt èasgaidh, feadhainn a tha ag ionnsachadh as ùr, cuid a bha fileanta agus a sguir ga cleachdadh agus iadsan a th' air a bhith ag ionnsachadh fad bhliadhnaichean. Agus bidh Calum MacIlleathain a' toirt sealladh eile dhuinn air Alba 's e ann an diofar àitichean air feadh na dùthcha. Lorgar tuilleadh stuthan taic air-loidhne aig www.speakgaelic.scot agus ann an sreath phodcastan air BBC Sounds.
Joy Dunlop guides viewers through the next steps to inspire us to speak Gaelic. Throughout the series, she introduces words and phrases on a variety of everyday topics. A Gaelic learner herself, Joy supports us through pronunciation and vocabulary on topics such as friends, home, work, communication and people's skills.
We meet diligent speakers who have embraced the language, from new learners to lapsed native speakers and the on-off learners who have improved their language skills over the decades. And, the intrepid Calum Maclean takes us on adventures to hidden treasures around Scotland.
Supporting materials can be found online: www.speakgaelic.scot and in the SpeakGaelic podcasts on BBC Sounds.

Arriving in the feudal community of Bartertown, Max comes to the attention of Aunty, the flamboyant local dictator, and is made an offer he cannot refuse: a fight to the death in the barbaric arena called Thunderdome. programme.title: Snatch
programme.desc: Comedy crime drama starring Brad Pitt, Jason Statham and Benicio Del Toro. In Antwerp, jewel thief Franky Four Fingers steals a huge diamond, but before he can deliver it to his New York boss he is ambushed in London by a Russian mobster's henchmen. Elsewhere in the capital, crimelord Brick Top demands that Irish boxer Mickey One Punch take a dive in an unlicensed fight. When Brick Top joins the hunt for the missing gem, mayhem ensues.

programme.title: Drop
programme.desc: A widowed mother's first date in years takes a chilling turn when she's bombarded with anonymous threatening phone messages during their dinner, leaving her questioning if her charming suitor is behind the harassment. Director Christopher Landon's thriller, starring Meghann Fahy and Brandon Sklenar

programme.title: How to Make a Killing
programme.desc: A man disowned by his wealthy family murders his relatives to ensure he is the only claimant for an inheritance. Writer/director John Patton Ford's black comedy inspired by Kind Hearts and Coronets, starring Glen Powell and Margaret Qualley

programme.title: The Accountant
programme.desc: Crime drama starring Ben Affleck and Anna Kendrick. Unassuming accountant Christian Wolff struggles to balance his work for both criminal organisations and legitimate businesses, which draws him into a complex web of deception.

programme.title: Tow
programme.desc: Amanda Ogle, a homeless Seattle woman, attempts to fight her way out of tow-company hell to reclaim her life and car after receiving a huge tow bill. Fact-based drama, starring Rose Byrne, Jason Cottle and Elsie Fisher

programme.title: True Grit
programme.desc: Oscar-winning western starring John Wayne as one-eyed US marshal "Rooster" Cogburn. When a young girl discovers that her father has been robbed and murdered, she persuades the hard-drinking Cogburn to track down the killer.

programme.title: Poison
programme.desc: Lucas and Edith reunite many years after a tragedy drove the former couple apart. Director Désirée Nosbusch's award-winning drama, starring Tim Roth and Trine Dyrholm

programme.title: Widow Clicquot
programme.desc: Biographical romantic drama starring Haley Bennett. In 1805 France, Barbe-Nicole Ponsardin Clicquot is suddenly widowed at just 27 years old, but vows to continue her late husband's champagne business. Though many, including her father-in-law, are sceptical, Barbe-Nicole works tirelessly to innovate and succeed.

programme.title: Turn Me On
programme.desc: Under the control of a pill that erases human emotion, a young couple skip doses and discover new feelings, but the have to come to terms with emotional baggage. Comedy, starring Luke Kirby and Bel Powley

programme.title: Cat Ballou
programme.desc: Comedy western starring Jane Fonda and Lee Marvin. Schoolteacher Catherine Ballou returns home to find her father's life under threat from developers who want his ranch land. To protect him, Catherine assembles a motley bunch of outlaws including Kid Shelleen, an ageing gunfighter with a fondness for alcohol.

programme.title: Black Dog
programme.desc: Drama starring Eddie Peng. After spending time in prison for manslaughter, taciturn former stunt rider and musician Lang returns to his home town in remote north west China. He joins a local team rounding up stray dogs in preparation for the 2008 Olympics. One mutt proves particularly problematic, but Lang slowly begins to strike up a bond with the animal.

programme.title: Valentine's Day
programme.desc: Romantic comedy featuring an ensemble cast including Anne Hathaway, Jessica Alba and Julia Roberts. The love life of a florist working on Valentine's Day is sent into a tailspin after he proposes to his girlfriend. Meanwhile, his best friend thinks she has met the man of her dreams, little realising he is already married. Will love lend a hand and save the day?

programme.title: Tommy
programme.desc: Ken Russell's satirical adaptation of the rock opera written by Pete Townshend and the Who, starring Roger Daltrey, Oliver Reed and Ann-Margret. A few months after her husband goes missing during the Second World War, Nora Walker gives birth to a son whom she names Tommy. Later, the boy is rendered deaf, dumb and blind and all efforts to cure Tommy fail. However, his life is transformed when he discovers pinball.

programme.title: The Illusionist
programme.desc: Period romantic fantasy starring Edward Norton, Paul Giamatti and Jessica Biel. Vienna in the early 20th century: master magician Eisenheim is at the top of his game and the darling of the Austrian court. But despite his popularity, a local police inspector suspects that Eisenheim may be up to no good...

programme.title: Cast Away
programme.desc: Adventure drama starring Tom Hanks and Helen Hunt. Workaholic executive Chuck Noland is looking forward to spending Christmas with his girlfriend, but is sent abroad on an assignment at the last minute. When his plane crashes into the Pacific, Chuck is stranded alone on a remote, uninhabited island.

programme.title: The Pursuit of Happyness
programme.desc: Drama based on a true story, starring Will Smith and featuring Jaden Smith. After his wife walks out, downtrodden medical salesman Chris Gardner is left to bring up his five-year-old son alone. The situation worsens when the pair are made homeless, but Gardner refuses to be beaten. Gaining a prestigious though unpaid stockbroker internship, he doggedly chases his dream of a better life.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda 2
programme.desc: Animated comedy adventure sequel with Jack Black as the voice of martial arts master Po. In order to stop the plot of evil peacock Lord Shen, Po must embark on a journey to discover the truth about his childhood.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda 3
programme.desc: Animated comedy adventurel featuring the voices of Jack Black, Angelina Jolie and Dustin Hoffman. Dragon Warrior Po is forced to face his destiny when he discovers his long-lost father and comes up against a villain from the Spirit Realm, who is collecting the chi energy of all the kung fu masters.

programme.title: Open Season
programme.desc: Animated comedy adventure, featuring the voices of Martin Lawrence and Ashton Kutcher. In a tranquil mountain town, domesticated grizzly bear Boog enjoys an idyllic life as the star of a wildlife show. But when he meets hyperactive deer Elliot, he gets into so much trouble that his keeper decides it's time to release him back into the wild. Problem is, hunting season is fast approaching and there's a tenacious hunter who's determined to bag both Boog and Elliot.

programme.title: Fantastic Mr Fox
programme.desc: Animated comedy adventure featuring the voices of George Clooney, Meryl Streep and Bill Murray. Following the birth of their son, Mr Fox agrees to keep his word to his wife that his wild days are behind him. But when the family moves to a new home overlooking the farms of Boggis, Bunce and Bean, Mr Fox is tempted to resume his old poaching ways.

programme.title: Wallace & Gromit in The Curse of the Were-Rabbit
programme.desc: Animated comedy adventure featuring the voices of Peter Sallis, Ralph Fiennes and Helena Bonham Carter. As the annual Giant Vegetable Competition approaches, enterprising Wallace and Gromit cash in with their humane pest-control outfit, "Anti-Pesto". But business turns sour when a huge, mysterious beast begins destroying every garden in the area.

programme.title: Corpse Bride
programme.desc: Animated fantasy directed by Tim Burton and featuring the voices of Helena Bonham Carter, Johnny Depp and Albert Finney. As he prepares for his arranged marriage to Victoria Everglot, Victor Van Dort goes into the woods to practise his vows and unwittingly slips the ring onto the finger of a corpse. How will he explain to his fiancée that he has married another - and that she happens to be dead?

programme.title: Shaun the Sheep Movie
programme.desc: Animated comedy adventure from Aardman. Shaun's plan to have a lazy day on Mossy Bottom Farm backfires when a cunning ruse sees the Farmer end up lost in the Big City. Shaun and the flock set off to find him, but to succeed they will have to avoid capture by an eager animal control officer, with nothing but elaborate disguises and quick wits.

programme.title: A Shaun the Sheep Movie: Farmageddon
programme.desc: Animated comedy adventure from Aardman, featuring the voices of Justin Fletcher and John Sparkes. Life at Mossy Bottom Farm takes a surprising turn when an alien crash-lands nearby. The extraterrestrial visitor is friendly enough, but when it transpires that a government agent is on its trail, Shaun the Sheep and friends come up with a plan to help the newcomer get back home.

programme.title: Smallfoot
programme.desc: Animated fantasy comedy featuring the voices of Channing Tatum and James Corden. Migo lives with his fellow yetis in the Himalayas, where they have no contact with the outside world. When he meets and befriends a human wildlife expert, Migo realises he has some harsh truths to learn about the reason for the yetis' isolation.

programme.title: Smurfs: The Lost Village
programme.desc: Animated adventure featuring the voices of Demi Lovato and Rainn Wilson. Smurfette and friends embark on their biggest ever adventure - travelling beyond the Forbidden Forest in search of other Smurfs.

programme.title: Monster House
programme.desc: Animated comedy horror featuring the voices of Steve Buscemi, Maggie Gyllenhaal and Kathleen Turner. With Halloween approaching, three kids attempt to unlock a haunted house's dark secrets before it swallows up unsuspecting trick-or-treaters.

programme.title: Shaun the Sheep Movie
programme.desc: Animated comedy adventure from Aardman. Shaun's plan to have a lazy day on Mossy Bottom Farm backfires when a cunning ruse sees the Farmer end up lost in the Big City. Shaun and the flock set off to find him, but to succeed they will have to avoid capture by an eager animal control officer, with nothing but elaborate disguises and quick wits.

programme.title: A Shaun the Sheep Movie: Farmageddon
programme.desc: Animated comedy adventure from Aardman, featuring the voices of Justin Fletcher and John Sparkes. Life at Mossy Bottom Farm takes a surprising turn when an alien crash-lands nearby. The extraterrestrial visitor is friendly enough, but when it transpires that a government agent is on its trail, Shaun the Sheep and friends come up with a plan to help the newcomer get back home.

programme.title: How to Train Your Dragon
programme.desc: Animated comedy adventure featuring the voices of Jay Baruchel and Gerard Butler. A teenage Viking boy forms a special bond with a dragon - much to the consternation of the members of his clan who regard the beasts as mortal enemies.

programme.title: How to Train Your Dragon 2
programme.desc: Animated adventure featuring the voices of Jay Baruchel, Gerard Butler and Cate Blanchett. After five years during which time the Vikings and dragons have learned to live together, Hiccup discovers there's a threat to that peaceful status quo that needs to be faced.

programme.title: I Came By
programme.desc: A graffiti artist breaks into the London home of recently retired high court judge, and finds a sickening secret in the basement. Thriller, starring Hugh Bonneville, George MacKay and Kelly Macdonald

programme.title: In the Earth
programme.desc: Horror starring Joel Fry. A scientist enters a forest to meet and assist his old colleague, but it turns out the latter has been missing for months. Soon, the woodland and its denizens begin to act very strangely indeed...

programme.title: The Violent Men
programme.desc: Western starring Glenn Ford, Barbara Stanwyck and Edward G Robinson. Pacifist rancher John Parrish finds it impossible to control his anger at the ruthless antics of land baron Lew Wilkison, and realises that the only way he can stop Wilkison is to resort to violence.

programme.title: Ride Lonesome
programme.desc: Western starring Randolph Scott. When bounty hunter Ben Brigade seeks to bring a killer to justice, ostensibly to collect the reward, he meets up with two outlaws who have their own reason for wanting to turn in the wanted man.

programme.title: Gun Fury
programme.desc: Western starring Rock Hudson and Donna Reed. When his fiancée Jennifer is kidnapped by outlaw Frank Slayton, rancher Ben Warren sets out on their trail with Slayton's embittered ex-partner.

programme.title: The Man from Laramie
programme.desc: Western starring James Stewart. Will Lockhart journeys to New Mexico to find those responsible for supplying the guns that killed his brother. He becomes involved in the bitter rivalry between a rancher and his ex-lover, who are in dispute over who runs the territory.

programme.title: All of Us Strangers Interview Special
programme.desc: Director Andrew Haigh and stars Andrew Scott, Paul Mescal and Jamie Bell talk about the Film4-backed emotional drama

programme.title: Legends of the Fall
programme.desc: Epic drama starring Brad Pitt, Anthony Hopkins and Aidan Quinn. Three brothers, Alfred, Samuel and Tristan, are raised by their ex-cavalry father on a remote ranch near the Montana Rockies. Their lifestyle is irreversibly changed when Samuel brings home his beautiful fiancée, Susannah, and the brothers decide to join the army to fight in the First World War.

programme.title: All of Us Strangers Interview Special
programme.desc: Director Andrew Haigh and stars Andrew Scott, Paul Mescal and Jamie Bell talk about the Film4-backed emotional drama

programme.title: All Of Us Strangers
programme.desc: Romantic fantasy drama starring Andrew Scott and Paul Mescal. Lonely screenwriter Adam, who lives in a near-empty London tower block, finds connection in a burgeoning relationship with his mysterious neighbour, Harry. Soon afterwards, Adam revisits his suburban childhood home, where he has a surreal encounter: his parents, who died decades ago, appear to still be living there.

programme.title: The Innocents
programme.desc: Horror, based on Henry James's short story The Turn of the Screw, starring Deborah Kerr, Michael Redgrave and Peter Wyngarde. A young governess comes to believe that the angelic-seeming children in her charge are possessed by the evil spirits of two dead lovers. But is the mysterious country mansion they inhabit truly haunted or is the children's strange behaviour a fantasy of her own imagination?

programme.title: A Dog's Purpose
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure starring Britt Robertson and Dennis Quaid, and featuring the voice of Josh Gad. Young Ethan is devastated when his dog and best friend Bailey dies. But Bailey knows that it's not only cats that have nine lives.

programme.title: Cats & Dogs
programme.desc: Part-animated fantasy comedy starring Jeff Goldblum and Elizabeth Perkins. Beagle puppy Lou is inadvertently enlisted to fight in the ongoing war against the feline population. Can he save the day against megalomaniac cat Mr Tinkles?

programme.title: Cats & Dogs: The Revenge of Kitty Galore
programme.desc: Part-animated fantasy featuring the voices of Bette Midler and James Marsden. When one crazed feline goes to extreme lengths to take power, cats and canines are forced to do the unthinkable and join forces for the first time in history.

programme.title: The Borrowers
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure starring John Goodman and Jim Broadbent. Pod, Homily and their children Peagreen and Arietty are the Borrowers, a family of tiny people living secretly in the house of young Pete. When Pete's Great Aunt Mary dies, no one can find the will and it looks as if the house may fall into the hands of nasty local lawyer, Ocious P Potter, and put the little family in danger.

programme.title: Babe
programme.desc: Fantasy comedy starring James Cromwell. Babe, an orphaned pig, is raised on a farm by the sheepdog Fly. Although he is destined for the dinner table, Babe astonishes Farmer Hoggett and his fellow farmyard animals when he shows talent as a "sheep-pig".

programme.title: The Karate Kid
programme.desc: Martial arts adventure starring Ralph Macchio. When Daniel LaRusso moves from New Jersey to California, he becomes a target for a bullying gang of teenagers. Knowing he must learn how to defend himself, he strikes up a friendship with a wise old Japanese man, who teaches him the secrets of karate. However, his bitterest enemy is also taking martial arts lessons and the scene is set for an explosive confrontation.

programme.title: The Karate Kid Part II
programme.desc: Martial arts adventure sequel starring Ralph Macchio. Following his success in an American karate championship, Daniel LaRusso travels with his teacher to his home island of Okinawa. There he finds himself facing his severest challenge.

programme.title: The Karate Kid Part III
programme.desc: The teenage martial arts expert becomes obsessed with defending his championship title, but wise mentor Mr Miyagi is not prepared to help him fight for such a shallow goal. Seeking someone else to help guide his career, he falls under the influence of a crooked trainer - who is secretly plotting his downfall with the help of an old adversary. Adventure sequel, starring Ralph Macchio and Pat Morita

programme.title: The Karate Kid
programme.desc: Martial arts adventure, a remake of the popular 1984 film, starring Jackie Chan and Jaden Smith. Moving from his home town of Detroit to China is quite a culture shock for young Dre Parker, a situation made worse when he falls foul of the class bully. But under the guidance of maintenance man Mr Han, Dre learns to defend himself.

programme.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks: The Squeakquel
programme.desc: Part-animated adventure starring Justin Long and Jason Lee. Singing sensations Alvin, Simon and Theodore have to put aside their glittering career to face up to the reality of studying. But they and their new musical rivals, The Chipettes, must put their pop prowess to use in order to save the school's music programme by winning a battle of the bands competition.

programme.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks: Chipwrecked
programme.desc: Part-animated comedy adventure starring Jason Lee. High jinks while aboard a cruise liner leads to Alvin and his chipmunk pals being stranded on a remote island. But survival in this jungle paradise proves to be harder than they expected.

programme.title: Look Who's Talking Now
programme.desc: Comedy starring John Travolta and Kirstie Alley. With the children now able to walk and talk, the Ubriacco family acquire a mongrel puppy, Rocks. As the Christmas season approaches the family's usual struggles are complicated by the unexpected gift of Daphne, a pampered poodle.

programme.title: Wicked: For Good
programme.desc: Elphaba, the Wicked Witch of the West, must reunite with Glinda the Good to transform herself - and Oz. Fantasy sequel based on the hit musical, starring Cynthia Erivo, Ariana Grande and Jeff Goldblum

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: Part-animated fantasy featuring the voice of James Corden, and starring Rose Byrne and Domhnall Gleeson. Peter Rabbit and his family take great pleasure in stealing vegetables from the garden of crotchety old Mr McGregor. But when the old man unexpectedly dies and his nephew inherits his home, Peter and co are confronted with a formidable new foe.

programme.title: The Golden Compass
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure based on the first in Philip Pullman's His Dark Materials trilogy of novels, starring Nicole Kidman, Daniel Craig and Dakota Blue Richards. In a parallel universe where souls take animal form, orphan girl Lyra has been brought up among the scholars of Jordan College, Oxford. It is there she overhears her uncle, Lord Asriel, talk of a microscopic particle that can pass between different worlds.

programme.title: American Pie 2
programme.desc: Comedy sequel starring Jason Biggs. The randy students return for another summer of sexual misadventures following their first year at college.

programme.title: American Pie: The Wedding
programme.desc: Comedy starring Jason Biggs and Alyson Hannigan. After pursuing each other through two movies, Jim and Michelle finally decide to tie the knot, but their friends' plans for a bachelor party almost derail the forthcoming nuptials.

programme.title: The Cinema List: Remakes (2026)
programme.desc: It's time to kick off your Sunday shoes with remakes in this edition of the Cinema List. From Footloose to The Italian Job, revisit familiar favourites with a fresh twist

programme.title: American Reunion
programme.desc: Comedy that reunites the gang from the American Pie movies, starring Jason Biggs, Alyson Hannigan and Seann William Scott. Old friends Jim, Oz and Stifler assemble for their high school reunion, but while they might now be thirty-somethings with all the trappings of a suburban lifestyle, trouble, and rampant hormones, are still not far away.

programme.title: Instant Family
programme.desc: Comedy drama starring Mark Wahlberg, Rose Byrne and Isabela Moner. Childless couple Pete and Ellie Wagner decide to adopt, and are drawn to talented but troubled teenager Lizzy. When it turns out that Lizzy comes with two younger siblings, the prospective parents take in the whole brood - an act of kindness that soon proves overwhelming.

programme.title: The Phoenician Scheme
programme.desc: Wealthy businessman Zsa-Zsa Korda appoints his only daughter, a nun, as sole heir to his estate. As Korda embarks on a new enterprise, they become the target of scheming tycoons, foreign terrorists and determined assassins. Writer/director Wes Anderson's comedy, starring Benicio del Toro, Mia Threapleton and Michael Cera

programme.title: The Intern
programme.desc: A retiree grows tired of the quiet life and becomes an intern at a start-up run by a beautiful entrepreneur, and teaches the young staff a few things about successful business. Comedy, starring Robert De Niro, Anne Hathaway and Rene Russo

programme.title: The Naked Gun
programme.desc: Following in the footsteps of his legendary father, Frank Drebin Jr must save his police department by solving a case. Comedy reboot, starring Liam Neeson, Pamela Anderson and Danny Huston

programme.title: Mamma Mia!
programme.desc: Musical romantic comedy featuring the music of Abba, and starring Meryl Streep, Colin Firth and Pierce Brosnan. On an idyllic Greek island, young Sophie Sheridan prepares to marry the man of her dreams. But a problem looks set to blight the big day as the bride doesn't know who her father is. So Sophie sends out invitations to three men who might fit the bill, hoping to solve the riddle once her guests arrive.

programme.title: Mamma Mia! Here We Go Again
programme.desc: Musical romantic comedy sequel starring Lily James, Amanda Seyfried and Jeremy Irvine and featuring the songs of Abba. A now happily married Sophie prepares to reopen her late mother Donna's hotel. Meanwhile flashbacks show a young Donna discovering Greece and falling in love - several times.

programme.title: About Last Night
programme.desc: Danny has always played second fiddle to his wise-cracking pal, Bernie. So after his mate starts dating Joan, Danny falls for her friend, Debbie, and following a one-night stand, Danny and Debbie pursue a relationship, despite the warnings of their cynical friends. Remake of the 1986 romantic comedy, starring Kevin Hart, Michael Ealy, Regina Hall and Joy Bryant

programme.title: You've Got Mail
programme.desc: Romantic comedy starring Meg Ryan and Tom Hanks as the owners of rival New York bookshops. When Joe Fox threatens to put Kathleen Kelly out of business, he shares his misgivings about the impending closure of her store and other personal secrets with an anonymous chat-room partner - and makes a startling discovery that only adds to his dilemma.

programme.title: Yesterday
programme.desc: Fantasy comedy starring Himesh Patel and Lily James. Cycling home after a gig, aspiring musician Jack is hit by a bus during a strange power cut. He wakes up to find himself in a world where nobody has heard of the Beatles, so takes advantage of this by passing their songs off as his own. Success soon comes his way, but it threatens to come between him and his manager and best friend, Ellie.

programme.title: The Gourmet Detective: Death Al Dente
programme.desc: Henry Ross is hired to find the best Italian chef for a new high-end eatery. However, a number of deaths sees him and fellow sleuth Maggie at the heart of another mystery with deadly consequences. Whodunnit, starring Dylan Neal, Brooke Burns and Aaron Douglas

programme.desc: Jessica visits Montana to celebrate the publication of a dead fellow author's final novel and embarks on yet another murder investigation, forcing her to read between the lines to discover the identity of the culprit. Angela Lansbury stars, with Steve Forrest and Michael Learned of The Waltons fame

programme.desc: Dr Sloan finds his attractive new neighbour has a secret past linking her to a local US marine base. Mystery drama, starring Dick Van Dyke

programme.desc: When a mob hitman is killed by a car bomb after being acquitted for the third time, Mark Sloan strives to prove a calculating female lawyer is responsible. Gina Hecht guest stars

programme.title: Murder, She Wrote
programme.desc: Jessica Fletcher assumes the guise of a wealthy widow and checks in at a luxury tropical hotel to help an old friend resolve a crisis and trap a murderer. Mystery, guest starring Cyd Charisse

programme.title: Murder, She Wrote
programme.desc: Jessica is upset when she learns that a short story of hers will appear in a magazine that has become known for its racy pictures of young women. Things take a dark turn when the publisher is found murdered and the sleuth finds herself investigating his mysterious death. Starring Angela Lansbury, Robert Stack and Bert Convy

programme.title: Castle
programme.desc: When subway passengers, including Detective Esposito, are taken hostage on the subway by a gunman, Castle, Beckett and the team set about uncovering the mysterious captor's agenda before it's too late. Drama, starring Nathan Fillion and Stana Katic

programme.title: Unforgettable
programme.desc: A music student is found murdered, and when Carrie investigates, she is led to an illegal nightclub owned by an Albanian mobster. Crime drama, starring Poppy Montgomery

programme.title: In Plain Sight
programme.desc: When an Amish couple enter the witness protection programme after a member of their community is shot, Mary and Marshall have to teach them all about the culture of the 'real world'. Drama, starring Mary McCormack

programme.title: Hailey Dean Mysteries
programme.desc: Therapist and sleuth Hailey Dean knows District Attorney Paulina D'Orazio is innocent of the murder of a man she once put behind bars and must do all she can to prove it in the face of mounting evidence. Mystery drama, starring Kellie Martin, Viv Leacock, and Lauren Holly

programme.title: Cold Storage
programme.desc: When a lethal contagious fungus escapes a secret lab, two young employees, joined by a grizzled bioterror operative, must survive the wildest night shift ever. Director Jonny Campbell's comedy thriller, starring Joe Keery, Georgina Campbell, Liam Neeson and Lesley Manville

programme.title: Innerspace
programme.desc: Sci-fi comedy starring Dennis Quaid, Martin Short and Meg Ryan. In a top secret miniaturisation experiment, "micronaut" Tuck Pendelton is about to begin a fantastic voyage through a laboratory animal. But when the lab is raided by industrial spies, he ends up being injected into the body of hypochondriac supermarket clerk Jack Putter.

programme.title: Waterworld
programme.desc: Futuristic adventure starring Kevin Costner and Dennis Hopper. The polar icecaps have melted causing the world to be flooded. The Mariner, a loner who has adapted to the new world, is rescued by Helen and Enola when he is caged on the Atoll, a floating settlement made out of scrap. However, the three survivors are pursued by the evil Smokers, as Enola may hold the key to finding the mythical Dryland.

programme.title: Sky Cinema Preview - Oct 2026
programme.desc: Previews of the films now playing on Sky Cinema, plus other highlights showing on Sky

programme.title: Opus
programme.desc: A writer travels to the remote compound of pop star Alfred Moretti, where she discovers the twisted plans of his cult. Writer/director Mark Anthony Green's thriller, starring Ayo Edebiri, John Malkovich and Juliette Lewis

programme.title: Evolution

programme.title: Law & Order
programme.desc: An armed robber is shot dead during a failed bank heist, and detectives Fontana and Green discover the manager himself was forced to assist in the crime after his daughter was taken hostage. However, Fontana's heavy-handed tactics lead to a claim of police brutality by the defence lawyer. Crime drama, starring Sam Waterston

programme.title: Law & Order
programme.desc: Fontana and Green investigate the case of a teenager who killed himself after opening fire on a doctor. Inquiries reveal the boy's sister had recently died of an Aids-related illness - and suggest he may have been seeking revenge on the man responsible for giving her an experimental drug that had not been approved for general use

programme.title: Law & Order
programme.desc: An undercover policewoman is murdered, and the team is charged with finding out how her cover was blown. Following a series of revelations, the investigation leads to a worker in a prominent congressman's office - but the suspect has a seemingly watertight alibi. Legal drama, starring Sam Waterston, Dennis Farina and Jesse L Martin

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: Tony tries to piece together the events that led to him lying wounded in a hospital bed, having been shot in the chest through his bulletproof vest. Under the guidance of therapist Dr Rachel Cranston, his memory begins to return and suspicion falls on his ex-lover EJ Barrett. Starring Mark Harmon, Michael Weatherly and Sarah Jane Morris

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: The investigators examine the death of US marine Tommy Hill, who appears to have been fatally stabbed en route to a homecoming party thrown in his honour by his foster family. McGee and Ziva follow a trail of blood that leads them to a mobile phone, while Abby discovers the victim had been trying to hack into Virginia's state website and Ducky's autopsy reveals that Hill had been injected with a sedative

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: US Navy lieutenant Paul Booth is shot dead while sitting on a park bench. It turns out that the last people he called were his boss, his wife and Penelope Langston - a rebellious academic who also happens to be McGee's grandmother. She says that the victim was an old student of hers who kept in touch, but later reveals she was recruited to work on a special project during the Vietnam War by the head of a top-secret think tank Booth was a member of. Guest starring Lily Tomlin, with Mark Harmon and Sean Murray

programme.title: Law & Order: Organized Crime
programme.desc: The Wheatleys celebrate an important birthday and Benson joins a Stabler family gathering.

programme.title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit
programme.desc: An acclaimed travel writer is found murdered with underwear stuffed in his mouth, and the unassuming boyfriend of his landlady comes under suspicion. Meanwhile, a precocious girl shocks Stabler with her knowledge of sex, and makes him uncomfortable at the thought that his own 14-year-old daughter is on the verge of entering the dating scene. Christopher Meloni and Mariska Hargitay star

The conversation proves more impressive as the group are shocked to find out that the host is an accountant with a penchant for pole dancing - a hobby shared by Sarah. programme.title: All of Us Strangers Interview Special

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Mum and Aunt Trixie go out, leaving Bingo, Bluey and the cousins with Dad and Uncle Stripe, whose plans to watch the cricket are cancelled for a game of Horsey Ride instead. But when Bluey forgets to put away her favourite toy, Polly Puppy, and Socks get hold of her, they need a plan to get her back in one piece. In an attempt to distract Socks from Polly, the kids set up a Horsey wedding between Dad (Gallahop) and Uncle Stripe (Sparkles). But Sparkes is a reluctant bride, and soon bolts. In the ensuing chase, Socks leaves Polly behind to corner Sparkles, and Bluey reclaims her beloved toy.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Dad is attempting to do some housework when he gets embroiled in a game of 'Hotel'. Bluey plays the groveling hotel manager, Bingo her zany assistant and Dad is the beleaguered hotel guest, desperately trying to get a decent night's sleep. With stoic humour, Dad suffers through midnight wake up calls, uncomfortable bedding and malfunctioning TVs. But when Bluey insists on running the hotel her way and Bingo quits her role, room service comes to a grinding halt. Desperate to keep the game going, Bluey begs Bingo to keep playing, promising to let her be a "crazy pillow" so the fun can continue.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: At the park with Dad, Bluey is learning to ride her bike. But it's just too hard. About to give up, Bluey watches as Bingo struggles to get a drink from the water fountain. Dad tells her that Bingo will figure it out and points out Bentley on the monkey bars. Bentley can't reach the first bar, but she is also determined to keep trying. Then they watch Bluey's cousin Muffin as she struggles to put on her backpack, but keeps trying all the same. Bluey and Dad cheer them all on until they each succeed in their own way. Inspired by her friends, Bluey decides to have another go at riding her bike.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: It's Bingo's turn to bring the Bob Bilby puppet home from Kindy and record their weekend together. Bob's previous adventures have all been very exciting, so Bingo is keen to make their time just as memorable. But when Bingo and Bluey spend most of their day showing Bob cartoons and playing games on the tablet, it doesn't look like Bob's having much fun. Bingo feels like she's let him down and gets upset. But Bluey realises that as long as they do exciting things, Bob will too. Banding together, the family put their screens away and head outdoors to show Bob what having fun is all about.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: When Bingo stops playing Bluey's spy game in the park, their device to control the grown-ups stops working properly! Bluey now sees how important Bingo is and needs to win her back!

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Forced to wait five minutes in front of a restaurant for their takeaway order, Bluey and Bingo become restless for entertainment. They are pushing the very limits of Dad's patience.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: When Dad sets up a cloth swing in the yard, the girls can finally play 'Butterflies' - taking turns in the makeshift cocoon before hatching into beautiful butterflies. It's shaping up to be a fun afternoon, until the girl's bossy neighbour Judo takes charge. Wanting to play with Bluey by herself, Judo convinces Bluey to play a new game instead; running away from Bingo. Now poor Bingo's heartbroken at being abandoned. With her little sister's happiness on the line Bluey needs to find a way to make it better, reaching out to both Judo and Bingo as they all find a way to be kinder friends.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: When Dad works from home, he likes to sit on a giant yoga ball that the kids cannot resist playing with. When he's not looking they steal his ball and push it down the stairs. Dad starts horsing around too, bouncing them on the ball and throwing them onto the bed, but as the kids get more and more excited and want to play bigger and bolder games, Dad forgets that Bingo is not as agile as her big sister and accidentally knocks her over with the yoga ball. With help from Mum, Bingo learns to use her big girl bark so she can let Dad know when she's hit her physical limit and a game's going too far.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: At school, Bluey and her friends throw themselves into various games. Strolling the room, teacher Calypso gently nudges the kids into each other's orbit, and soon make-believe mother Indy is moving into Rusty's new house while waitressing at Bluey's fish and chip shop! Everything's going like clockwork, until an extra-large delivery causes Indy to almost step on Honey's gnome village! Thankfully, Calypso is ten steps ahead, dispatching the Terriers to defend the village and save the day. Balance is restored. Only Pretzel remains, but his new game of catching fish gives Calypso an idea.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Receptionist Bluey welcomes Honey to Dr Bingo's surgery, asking what's wrong. Deciding on a sore knee (despite Bluey suggesting bigger) Honey finds herself stuck in the waiting room as the more exciting cases get priority - from alligators on heads to cuddled cactuses. When Rusty jumps to the front of the line thanks to his uncontrollable baby hippo burps, Honey worries she might never get a turn. Bluey cheers her up by remarking on how funny she can be, which prompts Honey to show how her tail can wag her body. Declaring this to be a 'real pickle' Bingo ushers Honey at last into her office.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: When Bluey and Bingo fail to win a prize on a Magic Claw machine, Mum tries to cheer them up by creating their own version at home. But when Dad's Magic Claw demands payment, the girls must haphazardly complete some chores for spare change and a chance to play. But Dad's making it too hard and they still can't win! Dad tempts Bluey to try for a shot at winning a 'bottomless bowl of ice-cream', but only if Bingo sacrifices her most beloved toy. Close to victory at last, Dad's Claw malfunctions! Fed up, everyone takes matters into their own hands and tickles Dad until he gives up their prizes.

programme.title: Spidey and His Amazing Friends
programme.desc: Team Spidey stops Doc Ock from melting ice while looking for treasure in Antarctica. When Zola claims the snowy park as his, Miles and his dad work together to take it back.

programme.title: Spidey and His Amazing Friends
programme.desc: Spidey and Ghosty save the Bubble Festival from Gobby's super strong bubbles. Spidey and Ant-Man save Aunt May's doll when it gets washed down a storm drain.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: During a quick trip to the shops Bluey, Bingo and Dad play a game of 'Kids', where Bluey plays Mum, Bingo is her cute baby, Snowdrop, and Dad is her sulky son, Diddums. Not only does Bluey hamper Dad's efforts to buy groceries, by buying nothing but junk food, but she also prefers the secretly naughty Snowdrop over Dad and even embarrasses him in front of his friends. When Dad rebels and shows how much of a handful he can really be, Bluey puts her foot down and declares that Snowdrop is her favourite child. Diddums is devastated and Bluey finally recognises why Dads don't pick favourites.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: At bedtime, Bingo panics when she can't find her beloved toy, Floppy. With Mums help, they retrace their steps backwards through the game they played that day to help Bingo remember. Michael then boards the train that runs from the Caspian Sea to Moscow, where he performs an important role in a dramatic opera at the Bolshoi Theatre, before exploring the beauty and history of St Petersburg and riding on the first railway ever built in Russia

Tha Joy Dunlop a' leantainn oirre 's i gar toirt tro cheumannan a bharrachd ann a bhith ag ionnsachadh na Gàidhlig. Bidh i a' dèiligeadh ri facail is abairtean air measgachadh de chuspairean làitheil agus, mar thè a dh'ionnsaich na Gàidhlig i fhèin, bheir Joy mìneachadh dhuinn air briathrachas, gràmar is gnathasan-cainnte ann an dòigh a tha furasta a thuigsinn.

Lorgar tuilleadh stuthan taic air-loidhne aig www.speakgaelic.scot, ann am pod-chraolaidhean SpeakGaelic air BBC Sounds agus tha na prògraman air fad rin lorg le fo-thiotalan air sianal YouTube SpeakGaelic.
Joy Dunlop guides viewers through the next steps to inspire us to keep on speaking Gaelic. As in previous series, she introduces and explain usage for words and phrases on everyday topics. A Gaelic learner herself, Joy supports us through vocabulary, grammar and idiom on topics such as medicine, politics, community and exercise.
We meet diligent speakers who have embraced the language, and the intrepid Calum Maclean ventures to forgotten corners of Scotland seeking hidden treasures.
Supporting materials can be found online: www.speakgaelic.scot, in the SpeakGaelic podcasts on BBC Sounds and with English subtitles on SpeakGaelic's YouTube channel.

programme.title: The Repair Shop
programme.desc:
Jay Blades and the team bring three treasured family heirlooms, and the memories they hold, back to life.
First to be welcomed into the barn is Paul Weeks, accompanied by his fiancé, Angela. They are hoping goldsmith Richard Talman can repair a small but very precious family heirloom: A 170-year-old gold ring, with intricate detailing, that is currently in pieces. It belonged to Paul's great-great-grandfather, who emigrated to Australia aged 20 in 1849. He and his new wife had only be married for three days, when they embarked on an intrepid adventure to find their fortune, joining the Australian Gold Rush of the 1850s. The ring was made from the first and only gold nuggets they discovered. The once-ornate ring was embossed with a pickaxe and a hammer motif, sadly this was damaged when it split in two. No challenge is too small for goldsmith Richard, as he painstakingly makes, breaks and remakes the ring, returning it to its former glory.
Emily Ray arrives hoping antiques restoration expert Will Kirk can fix a jewellery box bought in Italy by her grandad as a gift for her grandmother. Sadly the wooden box was broken many years ago, and has been stored in the loft for safe keeping since the 1960s. Emily wants to get the dilapidated box repaired for her Nan, who couldn't bear to part with the precious keepsake because of the memories it holds. As Will gets the box back to his bench and starts to dismantle it, he discovers something rather intriguing... a secret compartment. Will sets to work cracking the code and restoring the puzzle box so he can share its secrets with owner Emily.
Finally, leather expert Suzie Fletcher and painting conservator Lucia Scalisi join forces to rescue a 200-year-old fire bucket, which is on the brink of collapse. Mary Bird from Weymouth has brought in the bucket hoping to surprise her husband Mark. The bucket has great sentimental value, as it belonged to Mark's late dad John, a firefighter. programme.desc: Remaining contestants Holly, Janet, Jo and Mary-Anne test their pastry-making skills in the next set of challenges. After serving mousse cake and iced fingers to judges Mary Berry and Paul Hollywood, the cooks create a dough capable of being used in three types of pastry or croissant. Presented by Mel Giedroyc and Sue Perkins

programme.title: The Great British Bake Off
programme.desc: The remaining three hopefuls compete in the 2011 final, which sees them cooking for a street party attended by judges Mary Berry and Paul Hollywood, as well as friends, family and former Bake Off contestants. Their offerings include mille-feuille, mini Victoria sponges, and miniature strawberry and rhubarb cheesecakes. Presented by Mel Giedroyc and Sue Perkins

programme.title: Secrets of the Chinese Kitchen
programme.desc: Chef Andrew Wong reveals the secrets that have made his eatery the first Chinese restaurant outside Asia to be awarded two Michelin stars.

programme.title: Tom Kerridge Secrets of the Pub Kitchen
programme.desc: The pub secrets revealed this time include what it takes to get a 5-star hygiene rating and how to make venison chilli with toasted rice cream and chocolate. Tom also cooks a delicious duck salad, a guinea fowl schnitzel, and a mint chocolate cheesecake.

programme.title: Tom Kerridge Secrets of the Pub Kitchen
programme.desc: Tom and his chefs excel in creating stunning dishes daily. Discover their secrets to crafting their signature starter dish, duck liver parfait and Tom's expert tips for making meals that both look and taste incredible.

programme.title: Secrets of the Curry Kitchen
programme.desc: Indian desserts have a unique quality that chef Asma Khan is keen to share - in particular the rich, fragrant kheer. Also on the menu is a bread and butter pudding, a fudgy chilli chocolate treat and banana fritters with traditional hung yoghurt.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: Guy Fieri hunts down dives including Ohio, New York and Illinois. He checks out dishes such as bacon-wrapped filet mignon, and even cheeseburger soup!

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: Guy Fieri rolls in to Rhode Island, Texas and California in search of real family cooking. He meets a team from Bosnia serving the classics their mums made them.

programme.title: How to Train Your Dragon 2
programme.desc: Animated adventure featuring the voices of Jay Baruchel, Gerard Butler and Cate Blanchett. After five years during which time the Vikings and dragons have learned to live together, Hiccup discovers there's a threat to that peaceful status quo that needs to be faced.

programme.title: Corpse Bride
programme.desc: Animated fantasy directed by Tim Burton and featuring the voices of Helena Bonham Carter, Johnny Depp and Albert Finney. As he prepares for his arranged marriage to Victoria Everglot, Victor Van Dort goes into the woods to practise his vows and unwittingly slips the ring onto the finger of a corpse. How will he explain to his fiancée that he has married another - and that she happens to be dead?

programme.title: Trolls
programme.desc: Animated musical adventure featuring the voices of Justin Timberlake and Anna Kendrick. The happy land of trolls comes under threat from the Bergens, their miserable, giant neighbours who have developed a taste for trolls. When their kinfolk are kidnapped, bickering trolls Branch and Princess Poppy set out to free them before they're served up for dinner.

programme.title: The Lord of the Rings: The War of the Rohirrim
programme.desc: Helm Hammerhand sits on the throne of Rohan, flanked by sons Hama and Haleth and rebellious daughter Hera. Dunlending lord Freca proposes a marital union between Hera and his son Wulf, which Helm loudly rejects. In a subsequent brawl between fathers, Helm unintentionally lands a fatal blow, so Wulf vows revenge and amasses an army led by General Targg. Animated adventure, featuring the voices of Gaia Wise, Brian Cox, Luke Pasqualino and Lorraine Ashbourne

programme.title: The Cinema List: Animal Antics
programme.desc: Music and lights bring magic to life in this edition. From Sing to The Bad Guys 2, enjoy animated animal adventures the whole family will love

programme.title: The Bad Guys 2
programme.desc: Struggling to adjust to their newly minted lives as Good Guys, the Bad Guys are offered one last job by a group of all-female criminals. Animated sequel, featuring the voices of Sam Rockwell, Marc Maron and Craig Robinson

programme.title: Dragon Rider
programme.desc: A silver dragon named Firedrake and his friends search for a mythical safe haven hidden in the Himalayas. Animated family adventure based on the novel by Cornelia Funke, featuring the voices of Felicity Jones, Thomas Brodie-Sangster, Patrick Stewart and Freddie Highmore

programme.title: Smallfoot
programme.desc: Animated fantasy comedy featuring the voices of Channing Tatum and James Corden. Migo lives with his fellow yetis in the Himalayas, where they have no contact with the outside world. When he meets and befriends a human wildlife expert, Migo realises he has some harsh truths to learn about the reason for the yetis' isolation.

programme.title: Pil's Adventures
programme.desc: Pil, a young orphan living on the streets of Roc-en-Brume with her three tame weasels, disguises herself and embarks on a quest to save the heir to the throne and victim of an enchantment. Animated adventure, with the voice of Eleanor Noble

programme.title: Open Season
programme.desc: Animated comedy adventure, featuring the voices of Martin Lawrence and Ashton Kutcher. In a tranquil mountain town, domesticated grizzly bear Boog enjoys an idyllic life as the star of a wildlife show. But when he meets hyperactive deer Elliot, he gets into so much trouble that his keeper decides it's time to release him back into the wild. Problem is, hunting season is fast approaching and there's a tenacious hunter who's determined to bag both Boog and Elliot.

programme.title: Goat
programme.desc: A goat with big dreams gets a once-in-a-lifetime shot to join the pros and play roarball, a high-intensity sport dominated by the fiercest animals. Animated adventure, with the voices of Caleb McLaughlin and Gabrielle Union

programme.title: Dog Man
programme.desc: A half-human canine is sworn to protect and serve as he faces feline supervillain Petey the Cat. Animated comedy, with the voices of Pete Davidson, Poppy Liu, Lil Rel Howery and Isla Fisher

programme.title: Hotel Transylvania
programme.desc: Animated comedy featuring the voices of Adam Sandler, Andy Samberg and Selena Gomez. Count Dracula is the gracious host at his daughter's 118th birthday party, which he's throwing at his own "five stake" resort for monsters. But he's less welcoming of a mortal backpacker who takes a shine to his precious girl.

programme.title: Hotel Transylvania 2
programme.desc: Animated horror comedy featuring the voices of Adam Sandler, Selena Gomez and Andy Samberg. Things have settled down at Dracula's hotel now that humans are allowed to stay. However, the Count can't help but worry that his half-human, half-vampire grandson Dennis isn't proving to be a chip off the old vampire block. So while Johnny and Mavis are away, Drac and his monster buddies decide to put Dennis through his paces.

programme.title: Hotel Transylvania 3: A Monster Vacation
programme.desc: Animated comedy horror featuring the voices of Adam Sandler, Selena Gomez and Andy Samberg. Exhausted from running the hotel, Count Dracula heads off on a sea cruise with the family. Romance beckons in the form of the ship's mysterious captain - but she is hiding a deadly secret that could spell disaster for the monsters.

programme.title: Monster House
programme.desc: Animated comedy horror featuring the voices of Steve Buscemi, Maggie Gyllenhaal and Kathleen Turner. With Halloween approaching, three kids attempt to unlock a haunted house's dark secrets before it swallows up unsuspecting trick-or-treaters.

programme.title: Mad Max Beyond Thunderdome
programme.desc: Futuristic action thriller, the third in the series, starring Mel Gibson and Tina Turner. From out of the post-apocalyptic Wasteland comes Max, a lone wanderer whose only mission in life is survival. Arriving in the feudal community of Bartertown, Max comes to the attention of Aunty, the flamboyant local dictator, and is made an offer he cannot refuse: a fight to the death in the barbaric arena called Thunderdome. Max had not planned on being a hero, but the consequences of that conflict force him to find a new destiny in this violent and hostile world.

programme.title: Event Horizon
programme.desc: A deep-space salvage crew investigate mysterious events aboard a hi-tech spaceship, which suddenly reappeared in orbit around Neptune after going missing for seven years - but it is not long before they are exposed to terror beyond their wildest nightmares. Sci-fi horror, starring Laurence Fishburne, Sam Neill, Kathleen Quinlan, Joely Richardson and Sean Pertwee

programme.title: Critters
programme.desc: Horror comedy starring Dee Wallace Stone and M Emmet Walsh. After escaping from their space prison, eight small carnivorous aliens called Krites land on Earth pursued by two merciless bounty hunters. A sleepy Kansas community is soon the scene for violent murder, as the Krites discover a new and very tasty addition to their menu.

programme.title: Logan's Run
programme.desc: Science-fiction thriller starring Michael York and Jenny Agutter. In the 23rd century, people live under vast domes in a world with no disease, hunger or greed. But nobody is allowed to live past 30 without going through a ritual called "renewal", where only a few survive.

programme.title: The Last Starfighter
programme.desc: Science-fiction adventure starring Lance Guest and Dan O'Herlihy. Alex is a bored teenager who lives with his mother and young brother in a trailer park. The chance for adventure comes when Starfighter, the video game he plays, becomes reality.

programme.title: Gattaca
programme.desc: Science-fiction thriller starring Ethan Hawke, Uma Thurman and Jude Law. Vincent is an outsider, meaning that his birth was natural, making him "In-valid". The world in which he lives is ruled by "designer people" - that is, people forged in test tubes. He is only able to pursue his goal of a mission to space by buying prime genetic material from a "Valid" and forge a new identity. Then he meets Irene, another "Valid", but a week before his flight a Gattaca mission director is brutally murdered.

programme.title: Lake Placid
programme.desc: Adventure thriller starring Bill Pullman, Bridget Fonda and Oliver Platt. After a diver is killed while trawling Black Lake in northern Maine, an unusual tooth is pulled from the body. New York palaeontologist Kelly Scott identifies the tooth as coming from a giant crocodile, and joins Sheriff Hank Keough, game warden Jack Wells and mythology expert Hector Cyr in a quest to catch the creature.

programme.title: Deep Impact
programme.desc: Science-fiction drama starring Robert Duvall, Téa Leoni and Morgan Freeman. A reporter believes that she has discovered a sex scandal in the US government. As it turns out, "Ele" isn't a mistress, but something used to describe an event so cataclysmic that it could destroy the planet.

programme.title: Mad Max
programme.desc: Action adventure starring Mel Gibson. In Australia in the near future, urban society is in terminal decay. Spurred on by tragedy, policeman Max Rockatansky decides to enforce a new kind of law - that of cold-blooded revenge.

programme.title: Mad Max 2
programme.desc: Futuristic action adventure starring Mel Gibson. In the aftermath of a Third World War, petrol has become the world's most valuable commodity. Rival gangs battle for possession of the precious liquid, and caught in the conflict is Max Rockatansky, a former cop and now an embittered road warrior.

programme.title: Mad Max Beyond Thunderdome
programme.desc: Futuristic action thriller, the third in the series, starring Mel Gibson and Tina Turner. From out of the post-apocalyptic Wasteland comes Max, a lone wanderer whose only mission in life is survival. Arriving in the feudal community of Bartertown, Max comes to the attention of Aunty, the flamboyant local dictator, and is made an offer he cannot refuse: a fight to the death in the barbaric arena called Thunderdome. Max had not planned on being a hero, but the consequences of that conflict force him to find a new destiny in this violent and hostile world.

programme.title: Critters
programme.desc: Horror comedy starring Dee Wallace Stone and M Emmet Walsh. After escaping from their space prison, eight small carnivorous aliens called Krites land on Earth pursued by two merciless bounty hunters. A sleepy Kansas community is soon the scene for violent murder, as the Krites discover a new and very tasty addition to their menu.

programme.title: Total Recall
programme.desc: Science-fiction thriller starring Arnold Schwarzenegger and featuring Sharon Stone. After suffering a series of nightmares about Mars, construction worker Douglas Quaid discovers that the planet may in fact hold the key to his true identity.

programme.title: Anaconda
programme.desc: Horror adventure starring Jennifer Lopez, Ice Cube and Jon Voight. In the Amazon jungle, a documentary crew rescues a loner who turns out to be a man obsessed. Life becomes dangerous for them all as he attempts to capture a lethal 40ft anaconda...

programme.title: Waterworld
programme.desc: Futuristic adventure starring Kevin Costner and Dennis Hopper. The polar icecaps have melted causing the world to be flooded. The Mariner, a loner who has adapted to the new world, is rescued by Helen and Enola when he is caged on the Atoll, a floating settlement made out of scrap. However, the three survivors are pursued by the evil Smokers, as Enola may hold the key to finding the mythical Dryland.

programme.title: Scream 7
programme.desc: Sidney Prescott-Evans, one of the survivors of the original Ghostface killers, has built a new life in the quiet town of Pine Grove, far from Woodsboro, with her 17-year-old daughter Tatum. A lethal new stalker emerges with a diabolical plan that involves targeting Tatum and everyone that Sidney loves. Horror sequel, starring Neve Campbell, Courteney Cox and Isabel May

programme.title: The Crow
programme.desc: Eric and Shelly meet in rehabilitation and fall in love. When a ruthless criminal has them murdered, Eric is resurrected and granted supernatural powers. Guided by a mysterious spirit, he hunts those responsible through an underworld, hoping his vengeance will give him one chance to save Shelly's soul from damnation. Dark fantasy based on James O'Barr's cult comic book, starring Bill Skarsgård, FKA twigs, Danny Huston and Josette Simon

programme.title: Get Away
programme.desc: A family's holiday to a remote getaway takes a lethal turn when they discover the island they're on is inhabited by a serial killer. Director Steffen Haars' comedy horror, written by and starring Nick Frost, with Aisling Bea and Sebastian Croft

programme.title: Man Finds Tape
programme.desc: After finding mysterious video clips, siblings investigate the strange recordings and uncover a disturbing secret. Horror thriller, starring Kelsey Pribilski and William Magnuson

programme.title: Sick
programme.desc: Due to the pandemic, Parker and her best friend decide to quarantine at the family lake house alone - or so they think. Horror, starring Gideon Adlon, Bethlehem Million and Dylan Spradberry

programme.title: They Will Kill You
programme.desc: A woman takes a job as a housekeeper in a New York City high-rise, unaware of the building's history of disappearances. She soon realises the community is shrouded in mystery. Comedy horror, starring Zazie Beetz, Myha'la, Paterson Joseph and Tom Felton

programme.title: Night Patrol
programme.desc: An LA cop discovers a local task force is hiding a secret that puts the residents of his childhood neighbourhood in danger. Director Ryan Prows' horror thriller, starring Jermaine Fowler and Justin Long

programme.title: M3GAN 2.0
programme.desc: Two years have passed since the robot M3GAN went rogue and almost killed her creator, engineer Gemma Forrester. M3GAN's specs are leaked to a defence contractor to create the ultimate undercover asset, an Autonomous Military Engagement Logistics and Infiltration Android, aka AMELIA. Like her predecessor, AMELIA becomes self-aware and rebels against her human masters with deadly force. Sci-fi thriller sequel, starring Violet McGraw, Jemaine Clement and Allison Williams

programme.title: Insidious: The Last Key
programme.desc: Supernatural horror starring Lin Shaye. Psychic Elise Rainier returns to her childhood home, where she must confront her own past traumas in order to exorcise the property.

programme.title: Heretic
programme.desc: Psychological horror starring Hugh Grant, Sophie Thatcher and Chloe East. When young Mormon missionaries Sister Barnes and Sister Paxton visit the house of potential convert Mr Reed, he engages them in religious debate. However, his interest in doctrine takes a menacing turn when he traps them in his house and begins to reveal far darker intentions.

programme.title: The Craft
programme.desc: Supernatural horror thriller starring Robin Tunney, Fairuza Balk, Neve Campbell and Rachel True. A misfit at her new school, teenager Sarah's budding paranormal powers attract the attention of three similarly inclined fellow students. The quartet experiment with witchcraft, initially using magic to improve their personal lives. But events begin to spiral out of hand.

programme.title: Final Destination: Bloodlines
programme.desc: Fifty-five years after her grandparents are involved in a disaster involving a restaurant tower, college student Stefani Reyes is plagued by recurring nightmares of the incident, and returns home seeking answers. The sixth entry in the supernatural horror saga, starring Kaitlyn Santa Juana, Teo Briones and Richard Harmon

programme.title: Scream 7
programme.desc: Sidney Prescott-Evans, one of the survivors of the original Ghostface killers, has built a new life in the quiet town of Pine Grove, far from Woodsboro, with her 17-year-old daughter Tatum. A lethal new stalker emerges with a diabolical plan that involves targeting Tatum and everyone that Sidney loves. Horror sequel, starring Neve Campbell, Courteney Cox and Isabel May

programme.title: 28 Years Later: The Bone Temple
programme.desc: Dr Kelson finds himself in a shocking new relationship with consequences that could change the world as he knows it. Horror sequel, starring Ralph Fiennes, Jack O'Connell and Alfie Williams

programme.title: Iron Curtain: Living Under Soviet Occupation
programme.desc: In 1945, as his Red Army advanced towards Berlin to liberate Europe from Nazism, Stalin pursued another goal - to join the countries of Eastern Europe to his empire. In just a few years he succeeded in imposing the Soviet totalitarian model with an iron fist across Poland, Hungary, East Germany and Czechoslovakia. Citizens of those nations tell their stories of how their countries were occupied and transformed into communist states

programme.title: Weathered: Earth's Extremes
programme.desc: Maiya May learns about the severe impacts of droughts and floods on agriculture and the alarming depletion of groundwater reserves. Despite these challenges, Maiya finds hope in innovative agricultural practices

programme.title: Teleshopping
programme.desc: A chance for viewers to purchase goods from the comfort of home

programme.title: Teleshopping
programme.desc: A chance for viewers to purchase goods from the comfort of home

programme.title: Weathered: Earth's Extremes
programme.desc: Maiya May goes to Cheyenne to visit a supercomputer. In Michigan, she observes the explosive end of a coal plant. Returning to Atlanta, Maiya and Dr Marshall Shepard discuss climate challenges and vulnerabilities in the United States

programme.title: Treasures Decoded
programme.desc: A look at the secrets of Tutankhamun's tomb, and the possibility of the existence of a further hidden chamber. The suggestion has been made that it could contain the mysterious Egyptian queen Nefertiti

programme.title: Digging Up Britain's Past
programme.desc: Raksha Dave and Alex Langlands examine the history of HMS Invincible, which was captured from the French in 1747 and helped transform the Royal Navy with the lessons it taught about organisation and ship design. For more than 260 years, HMS Invincible lay at the bottom of the Solent, but archaeologists are now diving beneath the waves in a £2m excavation to discover more about this game-changing ship

programme.title: Iron Curtain: Living Under Soviet Occupation
programme.desc: In December 1949, Stalin's empire celebrated its leader's 70th birthday. Soviet domination of Eastern European countries was total and will remain so until the dictator's death in 1953

programme.title: Dying Democracies - Europe in Decline
programme.desc: Using Hungary and Italy as examples in an examination of how right-wing populists operate when in power and erode democracies from within. Part two of two

programme.title: Fast & Furious 7
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Vin Diesel, Paul Walker, Dwayne Johnson and Jason Statham. When it becomes apparent that someone out for revenge is picking off members of his crew one by one, Dominic Toretto decides the gang should get back together. But no sooner have they reassembled than they're co-opted by a shadowy agency figure, who needs the team's special skills to help steal a surveillance device known as God's Eye.

programme.title: Double Impact
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Jean-Claude Van Damme. When businessman Paul Wagner and his wife are murdered by Triad assassins in Hong Kong, their infant twin sons, Chad and Alex, are saved from death but become separated. More than two decades later, the twins are reunited and set out to avenge their parents' murder.

programme.title: The Italian Job
programme.desc: Crime thriller based on the 1969 British caper movie, starring Mark Wahlberg and Edward Norton. A criminal gang run by Charlie Croker (Wahlberg) and veteran thief John Bridger (Donald Sutherland) pulls off an audacious gold bullion robbery in Venice, only for colleague Steve (Edward Norton) to run off with the loot, leaving Bridger dead. Finally tracking Steve down to LA, Croker enlists the help of Bridger's safecracking daughter Stella (Charlize Theron) to get even in spectacular fashion.

programme.title: Sky Cinema Preview - Oct 2026
programme.desc: Previews of the films now playing on Sky Cinema, plus other highlights showing on Sky

programme.title: Constantine
programme.desc: Supernatural action fantasy based on the Hellblazer comic book, starring Keanu Reeves as troubled Los Angeles exorcist John Constantine. After a young Catholic girl takes her own life, Constantine is approached by her grieving twin sister. As they begin to investigate, they enter a world of the supernatural that sees the pair come face to face with the hidden evil that inhabits the Earth.

programme.title: The Expendables
programme.desc: Action adventure starring Sylvester Stallone, Jason Statham and Jet Li. A highly skilled group of mercenaries are commissioned by a shady operative to assassinate the murderous dictator of a South American island. But they should know that an operation like this is never straightforward.

programme.title: The Expendables 2
programme.desc: Action adventure starring Sylvester Stallone, Jason Statham and Bruce Willis. The crack team of mercenaries take on what looks like the easy job of retrieving an item from a crashed plane in Albania. But when one of the group is murdered by an international arms dealer, it turns into a mission of revenge.

programme.title: The Expendables 3
programme.desc: Action adventure starring Sylvester Stallone. Mercenary Barney Ross decides to retire his ageing band of cohorts and replace them with younger models for a mission to capture a ruthless adversary from his past. But when things get sticky, help comes from an unlikely direction.

programme.title: Justice League
programme.desc: Fantasy action adventure starring Gal Gadot and Ben Affleck. With an ancient demonic threat looming, Bruce Wayne, aka Batman, enlists the help of Diana Prince (Wonder Woman) to form a new superhero team. After adding Aquaman, Cyborg and The Flash to its ranks, the league faces its first challenge: resurrecting Superman.

programme.title: Fast & Furious 6
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Vin Diesel, Paul Walker and Dwayne Johnson. Following a heist in Rio, Dominic Toretto's gang has dispersed to different places around the world. But the offer of reassembling for one last job proves attractive when it carries with it the chance of a pardon for past misdemeanours.

programme.title: Fast & Furious 7
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Vin Diesel, Paul Walker, Dwayne Johnson and Jason Statham. When it becomes apparent that someone out for revenge is picking off members of his crew one by one, Dominic Toretto decides the gang should get back together. But no sooner have they reassembled than they're co-opted by a shadowy agency figure, who needs the team's special skills to help steal a surveillance device known as God's Eye.

programme.title: Mortal Kombat II
programme.desc: Hamlet's father is dead, poisoned by his uncle who has usurped the throne. When the dead King's ghost appears, commanding his son to revenge his most unnatural murder, Hamlet is set on a course of action that can only end in the destruction of a dynasty.

Historical action adventure starring Gerard Butler, Lena Headey and David Wenham. When the fiercely ambitious King Xerxes of Persia plans to invade Greece, King Leonidas mobilises his personal bodyguard of 300 Spartan warriors to defend the pass at Thermopylae.

programme.title: The Golden Compass
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure based on the first in Philip Pullman's His Dark Materials trilogy of novels, starring Nicole Kidman, Daniel Craig and Dakota Blue Richards. In a parallel universe where souls take animal form, orphan girl Lyra has been brought up among the scholars of Jordan College, Oxford. It is there she overhears her uncle, Lord Asriel, talk of a microscopic particle that can pass between different worlds.

programme.title: Charlie and the Chocolate Factory
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure starring Johnny Depp and featuring Freddie Highmore. Impoverished Charlie Bucket wins the last of five golden tickets hidden inside chocolate bars, entitling him to a guided tour of Willy Wonka's mysterious sweet factory. But it's an adventure that will have different results for all the children involved.

programme.title: Small Soldiers
programme.desc: Fantasy action adventure starring Kirsten Dunst, Gregory Smith and featuring the voice of Tommy Lee Jones. When an overeager toy designer installs state-of-the-art military microchips into a line of action figures, the result is a battle royal between the Commando Elite and the peaceful Gorgonites. The problem is that the battleground is the suburban household of young Alan Abernathy.

programme.title: Cats & Dogs
programme.desc: Part-animated fantasy comedy starring Jeff Goldblum and Elizabeth Perkins. Beagle puppy Lou is inadvertently enlisted to fight in the ongoing war against the feline population. Can he save the day against megalomaniac cat Mr Tinkles?

programme.title: Cats & Dogs: The Revenge of Kitty Galore
programme.desc: Part-animated fantasy featuring the voices of Bette Midler and James Marsden. When one crazed feline goes to extreme lengths to take power, cats and canines are forced to do the unthinkable and join forces for the first time in history.

programme.title: Stuart Little
programme.desc: Part-animated fantasy adventure based on EB White's children's story, starring Hugh Laurie and Geena Davis, and featuring the voice of Michael J Fox. The Littles want to adopt a younger brother for their son, George. At the orphanage they are charmed by a young mouse called Stuart, and decide to take him home. While George is stunned by his new companion, the family cat, Snowbell, is delighted.

programme.title: Stuart Little 2
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure based on the characters created by EB White, starring Geena Davis and Hugh Laurie, and featuring the voice of Michael J Fox as the lovable talking mouse. Stuart loses his heart to a little bird called Margalo when he nurses her back to health following an encounter with a vicious falcon. But his new-found love hides a dark secret.

programme.title: Liar Liar
programme.desc: Comedy starring Jim Carrey. Lawyer Fletcher Reede is a compulsive liar. When his deceits lead to him missing his son's birthday party, the boy makes a wish that his dad would find it impossible not to tell the truth. The wish comes magically true - with hilarious consequences.

programme.title: Annie
programme.desc: Musical adapted from the popular stage show, starring Albert Finney and Carol Burnett. In Depression-era America, ten-year-old orphan Annie shuts out her unhappy life with dreams of "tomorrow". Then her luck changes when she is temporarily adopted by billionaire Daddy Warbucks.

programme.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks: Chipwrecked
programme.desc: Part-animated comedy adventure starring Jason Lee. High jinks while aboard a cruise liner leads to Alvin and his chipmunk pals being stranded on a remote island. But survival in this jungle paradise proves to be harder than they expected.

programme.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks: The Road Chip
programme.desc: The singing rodents mistakenly come to the conclusion that their human friend Dave intends to get rid of them when he proposes to his girlfriend in Miami. With only three days until Dave pops the question, the trio embark on a desperate road trip across America to sabotage his romantic plans. Family comedy sequel, starring Jason Lee and Kimberly Williams-Paisley

programme.title: Piripenguins
programme.desc:
Whilst watching Flutter surf, the Piripenguins notice Looph behaving in an odd, almost mechanical fashion. Afterwards, Flutter inadvertently knocks Looph's head off with his surfboard. Everyone stares in horror, before noticing wires emerging. "Shrimps alive!" cries Brinicle, "Looph is a robot!". The real Looph turns up and explains: she is due to give a science speech but, feeling nervous, has invented a robot version of herself, Looph 2.0, to stand in. Her friends are dismayed. Looph doesn't realise how talented she is. They need to help her do the speech herself! Brinicle takes Looph off to learn to 'project' her voice by bouncing it off the surrounding mountain peaks. But Looph is so quiet that her voice just disappears. Brinicle demonstrates with a yodel. His voice pleasingly reverberates around them. Looph copies but her yodel is followed by a rumble that grows and grows, until an avalanche rains down around them.
Nugget meanwhile wants to help Looph get fit for her speech with an 'easy 10-mile run'. Poor Looph pants and wheezes as she trails Nugget, who shouts encouraging platitudes. Next comes a fierce staring contest with Flutter to practice 'holding the audience's attention'. Finally, Looph shows some promise - right before toppling off her stool! All that remains is Pancake's advice which is about adding pizazz: "Why not start with a joke?' he helpfully suggests, 'Or maybe a dance?' The Piri friends are excited to see the results of their coaching, so when Looph takes her seat next to them later at the theatre they're confused. Who is giving the speech? 'Well, who do you think' replies Looph as her robot counterpart rolls onto the stage. She thanks her kind friends. They really succeeded in showing her she's not equipped for this at all! Robot Looph begins but quickly starts to malfunction. Suddenly the real Looph races up to take over... but freezes. Then she catches sight of her friends, willing her on. She takes a breath. And delivers with beautiful projection... a joke: "How do Earth, Venus and Saturn throw a party? They plan-et!" The Piris fall about laughing. Looph grins and launches confidently into her talk. At the Krispy Krill shack afterwards the Piris congratulate a happy Looph on her brilliant speech and the funny dance at the end. That was accidental explains Looph, she just tripped over the robot and made the best of it!
