programme.title: Steam Train Britain
programme.desc: At the Ffestiniog and Welsh Highlands Railway, manager Stephen Greig is trying to ensure that all goes to plan ahead of the opening of the new station at Caernarfon.

programme.title: Steam Train Britain
programme.desc: At South Devon, Ray Lee is working to bring a loco back in to service. There is a visit to the SS Kingswear paddle steamer In Dartmouth, the oldest vessel of its kind.

programme.title: Steam Train Britain
programme.desc: On the Welsh Highland Railway, trainee Claire Oates takes her driving test, while chef Alex and manager Michelle prepare a dinner for 130 people on the East Lancashire railway.

programme.title: Steam Train Britain
programme.desc: At the East Lancashire Railway, the annual Race the Train event gets under way - with athletes of all abilities taking on the 11-mile course from Bury to Rawtenstall.

programme.title: Steam Train Britain
programme.desc: Meeting the Welsh Highland Railway's oldest volunteer fireman, 80-year-old Cedric Lodge, who has worked on the railways for 60 years. In Devon, there is a look at the Autotrain.

programme.title: Great Coastal Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo joins the hunt for dark matter in the deepest mine in Britain in Boulby, North Yorkshire, then visits Middlesbrough's Transporter Bridge, which offers high views over the Tees estuary and the Cleveland Hills. At Saltholme, Michael joins the RSPB in a hide to observe a visiting bird of prey

programme.title: Great Coastal Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo is in the glens of Antrim, where he is transfixed by tales of fairies and legends of the sea. At the entrance to Belfast Lough in Whitehead he discovers a museum which tells the story of Ireland's railway heritage. He also sees if he has what it takes to join the local rowing club. At the medieval Carrickfergus Castle, Michael learns of the town's important role in the history of Ireland, when William of Orange landed at its harbour and went on to fight the Battle of the Boyne, which is commemorated by Unionists to this day

programme.title: Blue Planet II
programme.desc: Creatures that live in volcanic hot spots on the ocean bed, areas that reach temperatures hot enough to melt lead and which may hold the secrets behind all life on Earth. Other strange creatures from the depths of the sea include bone-eating worms, fish that walk rather than swim, and hordes of squid. Plus, footage of sharks in a feeding frenzy over the dead body of a whale and the wildlife of the Midnight Zone in the Pacific, an area that never receives any natural light, forcing creatures to rely on their own bioluminescence

programme.title: Blue Planet II
programme.desc: Creatures that live on coral reefs, including groupers, small predators that scientists believe are as intelligent as chimpanzees. These creatures have a remarkable aptitude for communication to the point where they can interact with other species including octopi and work together to catch prey. Plus, footage of a vast spawning event involving several different species of fish, coral and invertebrates, and time-lapse photography of coral polyps growing and dying, creating a structure visible from space

programme.title: Blue Planet II
programme.desc: Wildlife that live thousands of kilometres from land, featuring footage of baby turtles using debris as life rafts and whales sharks embarking on lengthy voyages across the Pacific to the point where it is safest to give birth. Special pressure-proof cameras are used to film sperm whales hunting for squid a kilometre beneath the surface and the impact of plastic pollution on the oceans is revealed

programme.title: Blue Planet II: Into the Blue
programme.desc: Footage of wildlife inhabiting underwater kelp forests, including thousands of giant cuttlefish spawning along a restricted area of rocky reef off the south coast of Australia. Males outnumber females 11 to one, which leads to fierce competition. Larger males use brute force to drive off competition, while their smaller rivals use deception by mimicking the appearance of females. The programme also features tiger sharks hunting for green turtles in fields of seagrass and spider crabs trying to avoid predators while they shed their shells

programme.desc: Comedy that reunites the gang from the American Pie movies, starring Jason Biggs, Alyson Hannigan and Seann William Scott. But unfortunately the new boys don't blend in as well as was hoped.

Inspired by this nocturnal, dog-eat-dog world of "nightcrawling", Bloom buys a video camera and spends his evenings in pursuit of accidents, robberies and fire scenes. However, as Bloom's scoops earn ever-more lucrative payment from local news stations, the line between reporting news and becoming part of it becomes dangerously blurred.

Elsewhere in the capital, crimelord Brick Top demands that Irish boxer Mickey One Punch take a dive in an unlicensed fight. When Brick Top joins the hunt for the missing gem, mayhem ensues.

Doug hopes to solve his problems by being in two places at once - but will he be able to stop at two?

programme.title: The Brady Bunch Movie
programme.desc: Comedy, inspired by the 1970s TV series, starring Shelley Long and Gary Cole. Los Angeles in 1995: the community is crumbling and the crime rate is spiralling out of control. In the middle of all this, the Brady bunch - mum, dad and six children - live a happy and idyllic existence, caught in a time warp of 1970s values. But the family is in danger of losing the house, so it's up to the kids to pull together and raise the $20,000 needed to save their home.

programme.title: Roxanne
programme.desc: A sensitive fireman believes he has no chance of ever winning the heart of a lovely astronomer owing to his large nose, and instead agrees to help a handsome colleague woo her, causing himself no end of heartache. programme.desc: Sports comedy starring Woody Harrelson and Randy Quaid. But Munson figures without the interference of his arch enemy and old opponent, Ernie McCracken.

A bookie is shot and fatally wounded by a mysterious woman while visiting the news-stand of deaf former actor Dave Lyons and his blind assistant Wally. Before dying, the bookie secretes what appears to be a rare coin in the stand's cash box. Dave and Wally are subsequently arrested for murder and embark on a chaotic quest to prove their innocence.

programme.title: Smokey and the Bandit
programme.desc: Comedy starring Burt Reynolds, Sally Field and Jackie Gleason. Bandit is a maverick driver who never refuses a challenge, and no cop - or "smokey" - is going to stop him. However, Sheriff Buford T Justice has other ideas, and the chase is on as the Bandit and his friends try to get a truckload of illicit beer from Texarkana, Texas, to Atlanta, Georgia.

programme.title: Bill & Ted's Excellent Adventure
programme.desc: Comedy starring Keanu Reeves and Alex Winter. California teenagers Bill and Ted are eager to succeed in a history exam because failure will result in Ted being sent to military school and end the duo's hopes of becoming heavy metal rock stars. Then a representative from the future arrives and assists their studies by enabling them to travel back in time.

One stormy night, high-school computer nerds Gary and Wyatt feed all the components of their perfect woman into their PC and are stunned at the result. programme.title: Chicago
programme.desc: Oscar-winning musical starring Catherine Zeta-Jones, Renée Zellweger and Richard Gere. In 1920s Chicago, chorus girl Roxie Hart shoots her lover and winds up in jail, believing her dreams of stardom are over. Enter hotshot lawyer Billy Flynn, whose clients include double murderess Velma Kelly, and Roxie begins to realise that there's no such thing as bad publicity.

programme.title: The History of Sound
programme.desc: In 1917 New England, unassuming music student Lionel Worthing meets David White in a bar. There is an instant connection between men with a mutual interest in the history of folk music, and they spark a passionate affair, conducted behind closed doors. Historical drama, starring Paul Mescal, Josh O'Connor and Chris Cooper

programme.title: Air
programme.desc: In 1984, Nike's basketball talent scout Sonny Vaccaro believes the company should invest its entire annual 250,000 US dollar budget in one prospect: 21-year-old NBA rookie Michael Jordan. Vaccaro travels to North Carolina to speak directly to Michael's parents Deloris and James. Drama starring Matt Damon, Viola Davis and Ben Affleck

programme.title: True Grit
programme.desc: Oscar-winning western starring John Wayne as one-eyed US marshal "Rooster" Cogburn. When a young girl discovers that her father has been robbed and murdered, she persuades the hard-drinking Cogburn to track down the killer.

programme.title: Coach Carter
programme.desc: Drama based on a true story, starring Samuel L Jackson. Businessman Ken Carter is recruited to improve the fortunes of a failing high-school basketball team. His exacting standards soon put the players under extreme pressure - both on the court and in the classroom.

programme.title: Escape to Victory
programme.desc: Second World War drama starring Sylvester Stallone, Michael Caine and Pelé. As a propaganda stunt, the Nazis arrange a football match between the national German team and a squad made up of prisoners of war. However, the PoW team see the game as a chance to attempt an audacious escape.

programme.title: Lee
programme.desc: Biographical drama starring Kate Winslet. As the Second World War rages, American fashion model-turned-photographer Elizabeth "Lee" Miller defies the expectations of the era and travels to mainland Europe as a war correspondent for Vogue. Reporting from the frontline, Miller captures indelible images of the conflict, including the horrors found in the Nazi concentration camps at Buchenwald and Dachau.

programme.title: One Battle After Another
programme.desc: Thriller starring Leonardo DiCaprio, Sean Penn and Chase Infiniti. Years after the collapse of his political revolutionary group, Bob Ferguson lives in paranoid seclusion with his teenage daughter, Willa. But the merciless Colonel Lockjaw, a one-time target of Bob's group, has been hunting its members ever since, and has unfinished business with Bob.

programme.title: Philadelphia
programme.desc: Drama starring Tom Hanks, Denzel Washington and Jason Robards. Andrew Beckett's career at a prestigious law firm appears to be taking off. But Beckett hasn't revealed to his employers that he is gay or that he is HIV positive. When Beckett is suddenly sacked after falling ill, he contacts lawyer Joe Miller in a bid to sue the company for wrongful dismissal.

programme.title: Dunkirk
programme.desc: Second World War drama starring Tom Hardy, Mark Rylance and Kenneth Branagh. During the 1940 British evacuation at Dunkirk, three individuals each fight to survive. As young soldier Tommy waits to escape the wartorn beach, a civilian sailor from Weymouth aids in the rescue efforts, while a Spitfire pilot provides air support and gains a singular perspective on the chaos taking place below.

programme.title: Almost Famous
programme.desc: Oscar-winning comedy drama starring Billy Crudup, Frances McDormand and Kate Hudson. Despite warnings from his overprotective mother and a veteran rock journalist, a dream commission from Rolling Stone magazine to accompany a rock band on tour proves to be a life-changing experience for 15-year-old aspiring writer William Miller.

programme.title: The Brutalist
programme.desc: Epic period drama starring Adrien Brody, Felicity Jones and Guy Pearce. In 1947, Hungarian architect and Holocaust survivor László Tóth arrives in America. After a rocky start in this new land, he finds his luck changing when he meets a wealthy industrialist who wants László to build an ambitious community project. However, for the tormented László and his wife, Erzsébet, this commission proves both blessing and curse.

programme.title: Operation Ouch!
programme.desc:
Dr Xand's favourite cold virus is the rhinovirus: that's one that gets right up your nose and gives you the sniffles. So when the doctors get a question in the lab asking why your nose runs when you have a cold, they decide to become rhinoviruses and attack the body's defences through a giant nose. We also get a chance to see right inside Dr Xand's nostrils when he sticks a camera up his nose to show Dr Chris a real-life, flapping bogey specimen - gross alert!
Dr Ronx makes a whole class of schoolchildren forget where their elbows are with a mind-blowing body trick you can try on your friends, and in Ouch and About, Ethan wants to know which is the strongest bone in his body.
Over in Australia, six-year-old Jakobi is flown by helicopter to Sydney by the Flying Doctors because his local hospital thinks he needs specialist care. Lucy goes to the hospital in Edinburgh to find out why she's woken up with a swollen face. And in Liverpool, Michael's foot has been run over by a car, so no surprise that he's ended up in the emergency department. Ouch!

programme.title: Horrible Histories
programme.desc:
Did you know that the Victorians invented films? Not only that, but one of the first stars of the moving image was Queen Victoria! Using real footage recently restored by the BFI, this special show takes a Horribly Historical look at the Victorians' obsession with film. We see some of Queen Vicky's very first filmic appearances (also featuring an initially reluctant Tsar Nicholas I), and also how the Victorians became obsessed with filming everything, from their holidays abroad to strapping cameramen to the front of a moving train (using only ropes) to make 'Phantom Ride' films.
Along the way we also meet the Lumiere brothers (one of whom looks a lot like First Dates' Fred Sirieix), Kaiser Wilhelm II, notable Victorian actor Herbert Beerbohm Tree, and we see that the Victorians were also early adopters of Fake News. The episode ends with a show-stopping song that traces the evolution of film from the Victorians' first forays through to the blockbusters we see in the multiplexes today.

programme.title: Wycliffe
programme.desc: A climber plunges to his death from a cliff face and a police informant claims it was no accident. Drama, starring Jack Shepherd, Helen Masters, Lynn Farleigh, Christian Solimeno and Paul Venables

programme.title: Agatha Christie's Poirot
programme.desc: Richard Abernethie is found dead shortly after disinheriting his sole heir and specifying that his legacy is to be divided equally among the remaining family members. Poirot is called in by his solicitor friend Gilbert Entwhistle, to ascertain whether the late Mr Abernethie met with foul play - and also finds time to investigate the murder of a beneficiary under the new terms of the will. Whodunit, starring David Suchet, with Robert Bathurst, Anna Calder-Marshall and Geraldine James

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Gated estate Challis Court is a tight-knit community for retired police officers, but when a new arrival is found dead, the other residents regard the murder as both an affront and a challenge. Barnaby investigates and realises that the killer is likely to be an ex-police officer too. Crime drama, starring Neil Dudgeon, with Tom Conti

programme.title: Downton Abbey
programme.desc: Robert has to make what could be a far-reaching decision about the recent bombshell. Rose, meanwhile, seems more concerned with persuading him to buy a wireless than what is happening to those around her - but then again, she's always been trapped in her own self-centred little world. In the kitchen, Mrs Patmore thinks she may have found a way to help Daisy cope with her studies, while Thomas' devious ways look set to scupper Baxter's friendship with Molesley. Finally, as Lord Merton continues to woo Isobel, Anna is reluctantly drawn into Mary's latest scheme

programme.title: Downton Abbey
programme.desc: Lady Mary's secret assignation with Lord Gillingham is almost exposed - until Violet saves the day. It seems that the battleaxe may have more reason than most to sympathise with her granddaughter's position when a face from her past reappears, hinting at a hidden past of her own. Meanwhile, Carson is dismissive of Mrs Patmore's latest problem, Branson receives a proposition about the estate's future and the circumstances of nasty valet Green's demise are scrutinised - again

programme.title: Downton Abbey
programme.desc: Sarah Bunting continues to wage her one-woman war against the Crawleys - before pushing them too far. Violet is too busy getting flustered about Prince Kuragin to notice, and finally confides in Isobel the truth about their shared past. Following her illicit trip to Liverpool with Lord Gillingham, Mary makes a decision about their relationship - but does it have any future? Thomas returns to Downton a shadow of his former self, and Baxter wonders if there's more to his mystery illness than he's letting on. Rose's father Shrimpie (guest star Peter Egan) is also back on the estate - with shocking news

programme.title: Downton Abbey
programme.desc: Lady Cora enjoys the attention Simon Bricker gives her, but is he about to cross a line - and does she want him to? Meanwhile, Rose meets a dashing stranger, Branson makes up his mind about Sarah Bunting and Anna is disturbed by a visit from Inspector Vyner

programme.title: Downton Abbey

programme.title: Midsomer Murders

Before long, another body turns up, making the detectives doubly determined to catch this terror of the fairways. John Nettles and Jason Hughes star, with guest appearances by Nicholas Le Prevost, John Standing and real-life golfer Sam Torrance

programme.title: Midsomer Murders

programme.title: Blue Planet II
programme.desc: Wildlife that live thousands of kilometres from land, featuring footage of baby turtles using debris as life rafts and whales sharks embarking on lengthy voyages across the Pacific to the point where it is safest to give birth. programme.title: Blue Planet II: Into the Blue
programme.desc: Footage of wildlife inhabiting underwater kelp forests, including thousands of giant cuttlefish spawning along a restricted area of rocky reef off the south coast of Australia. Males outnumber females 11 to one, which leads to fierce competition. Larger males use brute force to drive off competition, while their smaller rivals use deception by mimicking the appearance of females. The programme also features tiger sharks hunting for green turtles in fields of seagrass and spider crabs trying to avoid predators while they shed their shells

programme.title: Mexico: Earth's Festival of Life
programme.desc: The first of three programmes about the wildlife, landscape and culture in different areas of the country explores the Sierra Madre mountains, and reveals how this rugged landscape has shaped the nation. This chain of peaks includes several volcanoes and is home to a wide variety of animals, including black bears, monarch butterflies, orchid bees and quetzals. The programme also visits the ruins of an ancient Aztec shrine and the blue agave plant which grows in the mountains is used in making tequila

programme.title: Mexico: Earth's Festival of Life

programme.desc: Footage of wildlife inhabiting underwater kelp forests, including thousands of giant cuttlefish spawning along a restricted area of rocky reef off the south coast of Australia. Males outnumber females 11 to one, which leads to fierce competition. Larger males use brute force to drive off competition, while their smaller rivals use deception by mimicking the appearance of females. The programme also features tiger sharks hunting for green turtles in fields of seagrass and spider crabs trying to avoid predators while they shed their shells

programme.title: Mexico: Earth's Festival of Life
programme.desc: The first of three programmes about the wildlife, landscape and culture in different areas of the country explores the Sierra Madre mountains, and reveals how this rugged landscape has shaped the nation. This chain of peaks includes several volcanoes and is home to a wide variety of animals, including black bears, monarch butterflies, orchid bees and quetzals. The programme also visits the ruins of an ancient Aztec shrine and the blue agave plant which grows in the mountains is used in making tequila

programme.title: Mexico: Earth's Festival of Life

programme.title: Mexico: Earth's Festival of Life

programme.title: Ghosts
programme.desc: In a bid to make some much-needed money, Alison and Mike consider selling some land. The plan proves far from straight forward however, with Lady Button up in arms at the mere thought of losing some of her beloved estate. Thomas enters a competition that he hopes will finally see him become a published poet, but hearing Lady Button speak so passionately about Button House gives him an idea or two. Pat and Julian get locked in a dispute and it is Robin who offers a surprising pearl of wisdom. Supernatural comedy, starring Charlotte Ritchie, Kiell Smith-Bynoe and Simon Farnaby

programme.title: Ghosts
programme.desc: Alison and Mike are forced to cosy up to Barclay if their plan to sell some land to the golf consortium is going to work. The ghosts become fixated on solving the mystery of Kitty's death. Supernatural comedy, starring Charlotte Ritchie, Kiell Smith-Bynoe and Martha Howe-Douglas

programme.title: Ghosts

programme.title: Ghosts

programme.title: Ghosts

programme.title: Ghosts

programme.title: Great Continental Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo ventures deep into the Black Forest, where he discovers how Hansel and Gretel helped to unify the German nation. A masterclass in carving cuckoo clocks demonstrates how the nation's reputation for quality and reliability in manufacturing was established. Later, at Goettingen University, the former politician discovers two sides of student life at the turn of the 20th century - the duelling fraternities and the ground-breaking scientists who laid the foundation of Germany's world-class transport technology

programme.title: Great Continental Railway Journeys

Moving on to Bologna, the former politician embarks on a doomed search for spaghetti bolognese before being taught how to prepare a tagliatelle al ragu. programme.title: Martin Clunes: Islands of Australia
programme.desc: With more than 8,000 islands to choose from, Martin Clunes visits 16 which provide an insight into the diversity, history and challenges of island life in Australia. His first stop is Lord Howe Island, where the pace of life is slow and the population is a steady 350. He also visits Norfolk Island, Australia's most easterly territory, and the remotest island on Martin's journey

programme.title: Martin Clunes: Islands of Australia

programme.title: Indian Ocean with Simon Reeve
programme.desc: The adventurer's epic journey continues on the coast of Madagascar, where he goes spearfishing with the Vezo people, whose lifestyle is under threat from their own rapid population growth. On Mauritius, he visits slums that show a different side to the tourist paradise, and he ends this leg in the Seychelles, meeting an Englishman who is turning his private island into the world's smallest national park. Simon also joins the Dutch Special Forces, training to board pirate ships operating on the high seas

programme.title: Indian Ocean with Simon Reeve
programme.desc: The third leg of the adventurer's journey takes him from the south of Kenya to the Horn of Africa. Along the way he joins a Ugandan peace-keeping force in Mogadishu, the capital of war-torn Somalia, which turns out to be the most dangerous leg of his journey as he ends up under fire on the front line. In contrast, he finds neighbouring Somaliland a stable and democratic home to thousands of Somalis fleeing fighting and famine. In Kenya's Tana Delta, he meets villagers facing eviction from an area that the government is turning over to sugar cane production for bio-fuels

programme.desc:
Tha Joy Dunlop gar toirt tro na ciad ceumannan a tha a dhìth airson ar misneachadh gus Gàidhlig a bhruidhinn. Thairis air an t-sreath, bidh i a' dèiligeadh ri facail is abairtean air measgachadh de chuspairean co-cheangailte ri gach taobh de ar beatha. Agus bidh Calum MacIlleathain a' toirt sealladh eile dhuinn air Alba is e ann an diofar àitichean air feadh na dùthcha.
Lorgar tuilleadh stuthan taic air-loidhne: www.speakgaelic.scot agus ann an sreath phodcastan a tha ri fhaighinn air BBC Sounds.

In the golden city of Salamanca in northwestern Spain, Michael visits the University to hear of opposition to the fascist takeover of Spain by General Francisco Franco, and gains access to the General's archive of enemies of the state. Travelling onto the capital city of Madrid, Michael hears how the bombing of a small town in the Basque region in 1937 inspired one of the 20th century's most shocking works of art, before making his way to the town of Huesca. Adventure sequel, starring Ralph Macchio and Pat Morita

programme.desc: Comedy sequel starring Steve Guttenberg. Given 30 days to halt the crime wave in his precinct, Captain Pete Lassard recruits six rookie cops from his brother's police academy. But the rookies' ineptitude and an ambitious lieutenant soon put Lassard's job in jeopardy.

programme.title: Instant Family
programme.desc: Comedy drama starring Mark Wahlberg, Rose Byrne and Isabela Moner. Childless couple Pete and Ellie Wagner decide to adopt, and are drawn to talented but troubled teenager Lizzy. When it turns out that Lizzy comes with two younger siblings, the prospective parents take in the whole brood - an act of kindness that soon proves overwhelming.

programme.title: Dumb and Dumberer: When Harry Met Lloyd

With the support of some old friends, including old flame Daniel Cleaver, she re-enters the world of dating, while also clashing with her son's dashing but uptight science teacher, Scott Wallaker.

programme.desc: Comedy starring Gene Wilder and Richard Pryor. A bookie is shot and fatally wounded by a mysterious woman while visiting the news-stand of deaf former actor Dave Lyons and his blind assistant Wally. Before dying, the bookie secretes what appears to be a rare coin in the stand's cash box. Dave and Wally are subsequently arrested for murder and embark on a chaotic quest to prove their innocence.

programme.title: Shaun of the Dead
programme.desc: Comedy horror starring Simon Pegg and Nick Frost. On the day north London slacker Shaun decides to sort his life out, the dead rise and the city becomes overrun with zombies. Can Shaun and best mate Ed fight off the marauding hordes of the undead and win back Shaun's girlfriend? Or will they just go down the pub?

programme.desc: Action comedy starring Simon Pegg and Nick Frost. London policeman Nicholas Angel is reassigned to a sleepy rural village, but soon finds that the big city doesn't have a monopoly on crime.

As Korda embarks on a new enterprise, they become the target of scheming tycoons, foreign terrorists and determined assassins. programme.title: Digging Up Britain's Past
programme.desc: Centuries ago, canals were the liquid highways of Britain, transporting raw materials and finished goods all over the country. Their arrival kick-started the Industrial Revolution, which was to turn Britain into a superpower. The very first water superhighway was the Bridgewater Canal, completed in 1761 to carry coal to Manchester from the mines in Worsley. Here, a team of archaeologists from Salford University roots out this industrial past, working with volunteers to excavate the very coal mine that inspired the creation of the canal

programme.desc: Action thriller starring Jeremy Renner, Rachel Weisz and Edward Norton. programme.title: Antz

In an ant hill that contains millions of inhabitants, neurotic worker ant Z has trouble conforming to the regimented way of life. But his mundane existence is changed for ever when he meets the beautiful Princess Bala and becomes involved in the sinister plans of power-mad General Mandible.

programme.title: Flushed Away
programme.desc: Animated comedy adventure featuring the voices of Hugh Jackman, Kate Winslet and Ian McKellen. Posh rodent Roddy St James leads a sheltered life in a Kensington mansion, with his every need catered for by his wealthy owners. But his life as a pampered pet comes to an end when he's flushed down the toilet to a subterranean world where the population is being threatened by an evil toad.

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: Part-animated fantasy featuring the voice of James Corden, and starring Rose Byrne and Domhnall Gleeson. Peter Rabbit and his family take great pleasure in stealing vegetables from the garden of crotchety old Mr McGregor. But when the old man unexpectedly dies and his nephew inherits his home, Peter and co are confronted with a formidable new foe.

programme.title: The Lego Ninjago Movie
programme.desc: Animated adventure featuring the voices of Jackie Chan, Dave Franco and Justin Theroux as the Lego figures. Teenager Lloyd is secretly part of a team of heroes who protect their city from the evil Lord Garmadon - who happens to be Lloyd's father.

programme.title: The Rugrats Movie
programme.desc: Animated comedy adventure based on the popular TV series. Tommy Pickles is feeling forced out by his new baby brother who just makes too much noise. But when Tommy hatches a plan to return his sibling to the hospital, it leads to some unexpected adventures.

programme.title: Rugrats Go Wild
programme.desc: Animated comedy featuring the voices of Bruce Willis and Chrissie Hynde. Young Tommy Pickles gets the opportunity to meet his nature-documentary hero Sir Nigel Thornberry, after his family vacation goes awry. Stranded on a desert island, the baby and his pals think they're alone, until they encounter the Thornberry clan filming their latest animal epic.

programme.title: Annie
programme.desc: Musical based on the Broadway hit, starring Quvenzhané Wallis, Cameron Diaz and Jamie Foxx. A foster child's life changes after accidentally meeting a workaholic tycoon running for mayor of New York.

programme.title: Stuart Little
programme.desc: Part-animated fantasy adventure based on EB White's children's story, starring Hugh Laurie and Geena Davis, and featuring the voice of Michael J Fox. The Littles want to adopt a younger brother for their son, George. At the orphanage they are charmed by a young mouse called Stuart, and decide to take him home. While George is stunned by his new companion, the family cat, Snowbell, is delighted.

programme.desc: Sci-fi action adventure starring Mark Wahlberg and Anthony Hopkins. When Optimus Prime returns to what is left of Cybertron, he is brainwashed by seductive leader Quintessa to return to Earth to obtain a mystical staff belonging to Merlin which will bring his home planet back to life.

programme.desc: Sci-fi action adventure from director Michael Bay, starring Shia LaBeouf and Megan Fox. Unsuspecting teenager Sam Witwicky holds the key to the survival of the human race when alien enemies the Autobots and the Decepticons arrive on Earth and continue their war.

Not only is the technology contained within it potentially devastating to humankind, but Sam is also dealing with relationship problems.

programme.title: Transformers: Age of Extinction

In order to get funding for her research, academic Alma takes part in an unusual study: she is paired with a robot, named Tom, who is designed to embody her "ideal man". Initially unsettled by her new partner, Alma reacts with hostility, but over time her feelings unexpectedly evolve.

Sharing his flight are three convicts being sent to work at a children's leper hospital. The five men must work together to protect the young patients when a volcano erupts, leaving them stranded with no easy way out. Adventure, starring Spencer Tracy, Frank Sinatra and Kerwin Mathews

Realising that there are no soldiers in his home town to protect it from reprisals, he returns to train the local women to defend themselves. Western, starring Audie Murphy, Kathryn Grant, Hope Emerson and Jeff Donnell

programme.desc: Adventure starring John Wayne and Betty Field. Matt Matthews, an Ozark Mountains moonshiner, has vowed since boyhood to kill a man he has never seen - his own father, who seemingly deserted Matt's mother and left her to die. It's an all-consuming quest that's preventing him from marrying his sweetheart, Sammy Lane.

programme.title: Decision at Sundown
programme.desc: Western starring Randolph Scott. After years of searching, Bart Allison rides into Sundown to kill the man that he holds responsible for the death of his wife. However, the object of his vengeance is now under the protection of the town sheriff.

programme.title: The Adjustment Bureau
programme.desc: Romantic sci-fi drama starring Emily Blunt and Matt Damon. A seemingly random series of events brings ambitious politician David Norris together with ballet dancer Elise Sellas, with whom he falls in love. But was their meeting down to chance, and are there now supernatural forces conspiring to keep them apart?

programme.title: Rise of the Planet of the Apes
programme.desc: Sci-fi action adventure starring James Franco and Freida Pinto. When scientist Will Rodman's programme of drug experiments to find a cure for Alzheimer's disease is shut down he secretly takes an offspring from one of the chimpanzees he was using into his home and names him Caesar. Caesar has inherited the effects of the trial drug and begins to show remarkable intelligence, a development that will put him on a violent collision course with the humans who have abused him.

programme.title: Nope
programme.desc: Sci-fi horror starring Daniel Kaluuya and Keke Palmer. Siblings OJ and Em Haywood have taken over their late father's California ranch, where they train horses for use in Hollywood productions. After a series of bizarre occurrences around their property, OJ and Em take measures to record and capture the source of the chaos: a monstrous UFO.

programme.title: A Clockwork Orange
programme.desc: Stanley Kubrick's controversial futuristic vision, dramatised from the novella by Anthony Burgess and starring Malcolm McDowell. Imprisoned after the brutal murder of a woman, Alex, leader of a gang of sadistic thugs, agrees to undergo behaviour therapy designed to turn him against violence. However, when he is released back into the community, the results of the treatment prove to be costly for the reformed Alex.

programme.title: Red Dragon
programme.desc: Thriller based on the Thomas Harris novel that introduced Hannibal Lecter, starring Anthony Hopkins, Edward Norton and Ralph Fiennes.Called out of retirement to help track a serial killer known as "The Tooth Fairy", detective Will Graham is forced to turn to his old enemy, the imprisoned Lecter, to help him build a psychological profile of the killer. But as the case develops, the line between who is controlling whom becomes blurred.

programme.title: The Big Heat
programme.desc: Film noir starring Glenn Ford, Gloria Grahame and Lee Marvin. When tough detective Dave Bannion is assigned to investigate a colleague's suicide, he is sceptical about the reasons given for his death. Forced to work under cover, he discovers the existence of a suicide note that implicates a brutal Mob boss.

programme.title: Strung

Panic takes a hold as the blaze begins to engulf the new tower and the fire department is called in for its toughest job yet.

After a rocky start in this new land, he finds his luck changing when he meets a wealthy industrialist who wants László to build an ambitious community project. However, for the tormented László and his wife, Erzsébet, this commission proves both blessing and curse.

Their lifestyle is irreversibly changed when Samuel brings home his beautiful fiancée, Susannah, and the brothers decide to join the army to fight in the First World War.

As a propaganda stunt, the Nazis arrange a football match between the national German team and a squad made up of prisoners of war. However, the PoW team see the game as a chance to attempt an audacious escape.

Despite warnings from his overprotective mother and a veteran rock journalist, a dream commission from Rolling Stone magazine to accompany a rock band on tour proves to be a life-changing experience for 15-year-old aspiring writer William Miller.

When Beckett is suddenly sacked after falling ill, he contacts lawyer Joe Miller in a bid to sue the company for wrongful dismissal.

As young soldier Tommy waits to escape the wartorn beach, a civilian sailor from Weymouth aids in the rescue efforts, while a Spitfire pilot provides air support and gains a singular perspective on the chaos taking place below.

programme.title: My Girl

Tomboy Vada Sultenfuss is not only a hypochondriac, but also preoccupied with death - a condition not helped by the fact that she lives above a funeral parlour where her father Harry works as a mortician. When Harry employs Shelly to help in the mortuary, Vada is concerned that her father and Shelly will become involved. So, along with her best friend Thomas J, she sets out to spy on the couple.

programme.title: Wuthering Heights

Mr Earnshaw 'acquires' an orphaned boy named Heathcliff during one of his gallivants and gifts the waif to Cathy as her pet. The children become inseparable, and as adults they embark on a destructive relationship. Writer-director Emerald Fennell's drama based on Emily Bronte's romance, starring Margot Robbie, Jacob Elordi and Martin Clunes

programme.title: Bohemian Rhapsody

So when local group Smile loses its lead singer, he convinces guitarist Brian May and drummer Roger Taylor to give him a shot. With the addition of bassist John Deacon and Bulsara changing his name to Freddie Mercury, the band Queen is born - but the path to world domination is a bumpy one.

programme.title: Stand By Me

Mattie's search leads her to "Rooster" Cogburn, a hard-drinking, one-eyed US marshal with a fearsome reputation.

Initially unsettled by her new partner, Alma reacts with hostility, but over time her feelings unexpectedly evolve.

The five men must work together to protect the young patients when a volcano erupts, leaving them stranded with no easy way out. Adventure, starring Spencer Tracy, Frank Sinatra and Kerwin Mathews

Realising that there are no soldiers in his home town to protect it from reprisals, he returns to train the local women to defend themselves. Western, starring Audie Murphy, Kathryn Grant, Hope Emerson and Jeff Donnell

programme.title: The Shepherd of the Hills
programme.desc: Adventure starring John Wayne and Betty Field. It's an all-consuming quest that's preventing him from marrying his sweetheart, Sammy Lane.

programme.title: Decision at Sundown

programme.title: The Adjustment Bureau
programme.desc: Romantic sci-fi drama starring Emily Blunt and Matt Damon. A seemingly random series of events brings ambitious politician David Norris together with ballet dancer Elise Sellas, with whom he falls in love. But was their meeting down to chance, and are there now supernatural forces conspiring to keep them apart?

programme.title: Rise of the Planet of the Apes
programme.desc: Sci-fi action adventure starring James Franco and Freida Pinto. When scientist Will Rodman's programme of drug experiments to find a cure for Alzheimer's disease is shut down he secretly takes an offspring from one of the chimpanzees he was using into his home and names him Caesar. Caesar has inherited the effects of the trial drug and begins to show remarkable intelligence, a development that will put him on a violent collision course with the humans who have abused him.

programme.title: Nope
programme.desc: Sci-fi horror starring Daniel Kaluuya and Keke Palmer. Siblings OJ and Em Haywood have taken over their late father's California ranch, where they train horses for use in Hollywood productions. After a series of bizarre occurrences around their property, OJ and Em take measures to record and capture the source of the chaos: a monstrous UFO.

programme.title: Four in a Bed
programme.desc: Farmer's daughter Mandy Sowray and her friend Anny Harrison host first at Laskill Country House in Helmsley, North Yorkshire. At dinner, Mandy bigs up her banger qualifications, but at breakfast she fails to crack Chris's order. Colin's feedback leaves unanswered questions for Mandy

programme.title: Four in a Bed

At dinner, Rammy opens up about his troubled past. Colin has a rude awakening in the morning. At feedback time, Chris has a change of heart about some of his guests

programme.title: Four in a Bed
programme.desc: Colin Warburg and his student son Ben hope that their 81-room country pile - Scalford Hall Hotel in Melton Mowbray, Leicestershire - will wow their rivals. After an afternoon crate stacking competition on the hotel's high wire course, Colin gets a grilling at dinner. A lukewarm reaction to breakfast only adds to Colin's woes and when he sees his feedback he suspects that retribution is at hand

programme.title: Four in a Bed
programme.desc: The final visit is to the Abbey Hotel in Battle, East Sussex, run by confident young colleagues Charlie Thompson and Lauren Tucker. At dinner, straight-talking Chris can't help but be impressed, but when the conversation turns to parking, the guests are in a jam with their hosts. Later, Colin's feedback leaves Lauren wanting answers

programme.title: Four in a Bed
programme.desc: The B&B owners meet up to settle some scores. programme.desc: Michael Portillo traces the early 20th-century roots of the Spanish Civil War, which divided his family and sent his father into exile. programme.title: Great Continental Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Armed with a 1936 edition of Bradshaw's Continental Railway Guide, Michael Portillo ventures onto the European rail network, beginning an emotional rail journey which takes him deep into his family's past. In the golden city of Salamanca in northwestern Spain, Michael visits the University to hear of opposition to the fascist takeover of Spain by General Francisco Franco, and gains access to the General's archive of enemies of the state. Travelling onto the capital city of Madrid, Michael hears how the bombing of a small town in the Basque region in 1937 inspired one of the 20th century's most shocking works of art, before making his way to the town of Huesca. Michael's final stop is on the border with France at Canfranc station, where he learns of the role the old terminus played in the evacuation of Jews during the Second World War

programme.title: Seòid a' Chidsin - The Kitchen Coves
SpeakGaelic
programme.desc:
Tha Joy Dunlop gar toirt tro na h-ath cheumannan airson ar misneachadh gus leantainn oirnn a bhith bruidhinn na Gàidhlig. Thairis air an t-sreath seo, bidh i a' dèiligeadh ri facail is abairtean air measgachadh de chuspairean co-cheangailte ri gach taobh de ar beatha. Leis gun do dh'ionnsaich i fhèin, bheir Joy dhuinn briathrachas a tha sìmplidh agus furasta a thuigsinn. Bidh stiùireadh ann cuideachd a thaobh a bhith a' cleachdadh abairtean, le eisimpleirean soilleir tro chòmhraidhean goirid.
Coinnichidh sinn ri luchd-ionnsachaidh èasgaidh, feadhainn a tha ag ionnsachadh as ùr, cuid a bha fileanta 's a sguir ga cleachdadh agus iadsan a th' air a bhith ag ionnsachadh fad bhliadhnaichean. Agus bidh Calum MacIlleathain a' toirt sealladh eile dhuinn air Alba is e ann an diofar àiteachan air feadh na dùthcha. Lorgar tuilleadh stuthan taic air-loidhne aig www.speakgaelic.scot agus ann an sreath phodcastan air BBC Sounds.
Joy Dunlop guides viewers through the next steps to inspire us to speak Gaelic. Throughout the series, she'll introduce words and phrases on a variety of everyday topics. A Gaelic learner herself, Joy supports us through pronunciation and vocabulary on topics such as friends, home, work and communication.
We meet diligent learners who have embraced speaking Gaelic, from new learners to lapsed native speakers and the on-off learners who have improved their language skills over the decades. The intrepid Calum Maclean takes us on adventures to hidden treasures around Scotland.
Supporting materials can be found online at www.speakgaelic.scot and in the SpeakGaelic podcasts on BBC Sounds.

programme.desc:
Màiri Anna NicUalraig agus Liusaidh Cooke - An Còcaire Fiadhain - a' rùrachd airson tairbheartas nàdair. Tha an ditches aig an taigh as t-fhoghar, a' coimhead air an lath dhen bhliadhna far am bithear a' trusadh airson nam preasachan a chumas biadh ri duine tron gheamhradh. Tha Màiri Anna is Liusaidh a' giollachd dhuircean daraich airson flùr a dhèanamh dhiubh, tha iad a' lorg balagan fiaclach ann an Loch Aills, agus tha iad a' dèanamh air Ceann a' Ghiùthsaich air thòir air measan cùbhraidh nan aiteann. Agus tha iad a' gabhail cuairt a dh'Eilean Èisdeil, feuch an trus iad sìol milis, blasta Lus nam Buadh agus far a bheil iad a' beachdachadh air deifir bhuill de theaghlach phlanntrais nan curran.
Mary Ann Kennedy and Lucy Cooke - The Wild Cooke - forage for nature's bounty. The two are at home in autumn, looking at the half of the year where cupboards are stocked to see through the winter. Mary Ann and Lucy process acorns to make flour, forage for hedgehog mushrooms in Lochalsh, and head for Kingussie in search of fragrant juniper berries. They also take a trip to Easdale island to harvest sweet and tasty angelica seeds and consider the different members of the carrot plant family.
In Gaelic with English subtitles

But his position comes under threat with the arrival of ambitious reporter Veronica Corningstone. Male chauvinist Burgundy is torn between defending his job and his attraction to the glamorous newcomer.

programme.title: Anchorman 2: The Legend Continues
programme.desc: Comedy sequel starring Will Ferrell and Steve Carell. After a disastrous move to New York in which he became estranged from his co-anchor wife and was fired from his job, anchorman Ron Burgundy is hired by a ruthless network executive to work the graveyard shift on the world's first 24-hour rolling news channel.

programme.title: Anaconda
programme.desc: Best friends Doug and Griff became obsessed with the film Anaconda when they were children and have always dreamed of remaking their favourite picture. When both men find themselves in the grip of a mid-life crisis, they fast track their film-making ambitions and head into the Amazon jungle with pals Claire and Kenny to shoot their slithering masterpiece. Comedy adventure, starring Jack Black, Paul Rudd and Thandiwe Newton

programme.title: White Chicks
programme.desc: Comedy starring Marlon Wayans and Shawn Wayans. Two black brothers are threatened with expulsion from the FBI following a failed drugs bust. In an attempt to save their jobs, they disguise themselves as rich, white socialite sisters to uncover and foil a kidnapping plot.

programme.title: You've Got Mail
programme.desc: Romantic comedy starring Meg Ryan and Tom Hanks as the owners of rival New York bookshops. When Joe Fox threatens to put Kathleen Kelly out of business, he shares his misgivings about the impending closure of her store and other personal secrets with an anonymous chat-room partner - and makes a startling discovery that only adds to his dilemma.

programme.title: The Naked Gun
programme.desc: Following in the footsteps of his legendary father, Frank Drebin Jr must save his police department by solving a case. Comedy reboot, starring Liam Neeson, Pamela Anderson and Danny Huston

programme.title: 50 First Dates
programme.desc: Romantic comedy starring Adam Sandler and Drew Barrymore. Womanising vet Henry Roth ditches his playboy lifestyle after falling for the charming Lucy. But a car crash has left her with severe short term memory loss, meaning that Henry has to romance her all over again every day in the hope that eventually she'll remember him.

programme.title: 21 Jump Street
programme.desc: Action comedy starring Channing Tatum and Jonah Hill. Underachieving rookie cops Jenko and Schmidt are given the chance to make their names when they are sent back to their old high school to infiltrate a drugs ring. But unfortunately the new boys don't blend in as well as was hoped.

programme.title: 22 Jump Street
programme.desc: Action comedy sequel starring Channing Tatum and Jonah Hill. Cops Jenko and Schmidt are back masquerading as students, this time to unmask a drug dealer with links to organised crime. But they soon discover that you can get too deep under cover.

programme.title: Team America: World Police
programme.desc: Satirical comedy co-written, directed by and featuring the voices of South Park creators Trey Parker and Matt Stone, and performed by Thunderbirds-style puppets. A counter-terrorism squad causes havoc as it does battle with the Film Actors Guild and North Korean dictator Kim Jong Il, who is bent on destroying the civilised world.

programme.title: Strung
programme.desc: A talented violinist whose new job tutoring for an elite family turns into a battle for safety and sanity when she realises her past is linked to the family's patriarch. Thriller, starring Chloe Bailey, Lynn Whitfield and Lucien Laviscount

programme.title: The Towering Inferno
programme.desc: Disaster movie starring Steve McQueen and Paul Newman. On the grand opening night of the world's tallest skyscraper, an electrical fault starts a fire in a storeroom. Panic takes a hold as the blaze begins to engulf the new tower and the fire department is called in for its toughest job yet.

programme.title: Borderline
programme.desc: A bodyguard protects a pop superstar and her athlete boyfriend from a determined stalker in 1990s Los Angeles. Director Jimmy Warden's dark comedy horror, starring Samara Weaving and Ray Nicholson

programme.title: Carolina Caroline
programme.desc: A young woman falls for a charismatic con man on the run, joining him on a reckless journey across the American Southeast. As their crimes grow bolder and their passion deepens, she searches for the mother who abandoned her. Crime thriller, starring Samara Weaving and Kyle Gallner

programme.title: Murder by Numbers
programme.desc: Detective thriller starring Sandra Bullock and Ben Chaplin. An overprivileged teenager and his bookish companion think they have committed the perfect murder, but emotionally damaged cop Cassie Mayweather has a hunch that they are the culprits. Her problem is convincing sceptical colleagues that she's right.

programme.title: Civil War
programme.desc: Action drama starring Kirsten Dunst, Wagner Moura and Cailee Spaeny. The USA is ravaged by civil war. Documenting the atrocities, a group of journalists - including veteran photographer Lee, reporter Joel and rookie Jessie - travel from New York to Washington DC to interview the President before armed secessionist militias reach the capital.

programme.title: The Accountant
programme.desc: Crime drama starring Ben Affleck and Anna Kendrick. Unassuming accountant Christian Wolff struggles to balance his work for both criminal organisations and legitimate businesses, which draws him into a complex web of deception.

programme.title: Snatch
programme.desc: Comedy crime drama starring Brad Pitt, Jason Statham and Benicio Del Toro. In Antwerp, jewel thief Franky Four Fingers steals a huge diamond, but before he can deliver it to his New York boss he is ambushed in London by a Russian mobster's henchmen. Elsewhere in the capital, crimelord Brick Top demands that Irish boxer Mickey One Punch take a dive in an unlicensed fight. When Brick Top joins the hunt for the missing gem, mayhem ensues.

programme.title: RocknRolla
programme.desc: A Russian mob boss sets up a profitable real-estate scam in London and soon every criminal in the city is after their share. The gangster's accountant hires a trio of crooks to take his boss's millions, while a rock star with a penchant for faking his own death causes further mayhem by stealing a valuable painting. Guy Ritchie's crime comedy, starring Gerard Butler, Tom Wilkinson and Thandie Newton

programme.title: No Country for Old Men
programme.desc: Oscar-winning crime thriller from the Coen brothers, starring Tommy Lee Jones, Javier Bardem and Josh Brolin. After going on the run with $2 million from a botched desert drugs deal, hapless cowboy Llewelyn Moss is pursued across Texas by sociopathic hitman Anton Chigurh and ageing sheriff Ed Tom Bell.

programme.title: Drop
programme.desc: A widowed mother's first date in years takes a chilling turn when she's bombarded with anonymous threatening phone messages during their dinner, leaving her questioning if her charming suitor is behind the harassment. Director Christopher Landon's thriller, starring Meghann Fahy and Brandon Sklenar

programme.title: The Accountant
programme.desc: Crime drama starring Ben Affleck and Anna Kendrick. Unassuming accountant Christian Wolff struggles to balance his work for both criminal organisations and legitimate businesses, which draws him into a complex web of deception.

programme.title: True Grit
programme.desc: Remake of the John Wayne western from the Coen brothers, starring Jeff Bridges and Matt Damon. When farmer Frank Ross is murdered by a hired hand, his teenage daughter Mattie decides to take the matter in hand and find a man with "true grit" to bring the killer to justice. Mattie's search leads her to "Rooster" Cogburn, a hard-drinking, one-eyed US marshal with a fearsome reputation.

programme.title: Legends of the Fall
programme.desc: Epic drama starring Brad Pitt, Anthony Hopkins and Aidan Quinn. Three brothers, Alfred, Samuel and Tristan, are raised by their ex-cavalry father on a remote ranch near the Montana Rockies. Their lifestyle is irreversibly changed when Samuel brings home his beautiful fiancée, Susannah, and the brothers decide to join the army to fight in the First World War.

programme.title: Sky Cinema Preview-Nov 2026
programme.desc: Previews of the films now playing on Sky Cinema, plus other highlights showing on Sky

programme.title: A Good Person
programme.desc: Allison is a young woman whose world falls apart when she survives an unimaginable tragedy. While in recovery for an opioid addiction and unresolved grief, she forms an unlikely friendship with her would-be father-in-law, Daniel, that gives her a fighting chance to put her life back together. Writer/director Zach Braff's drama, starring Florence Pugh and Morgan Freeman

programme.title: Air
programme.desc: In 1984, Nike's basketball talent scout Sonny Vaccaro believes the company should invest its entire annual 250,000 US dollar budget in one prospect: 21-year-old NBA rookie Michael Jordan. Vaccaro travels to North Carolina to speak directly to Michael's parents Deloris and James. Drama starring Matt Damon, Viola Davis and Ben Affleck

programme.title: My Girl
programme.desc: Romantic drama starring Dan Aykroyd, Jamie Lee Curtis and Macaulay Culkin. Tomboy Vada Sultenfuss is not only a hypochondriac, but also preoccupied with death - a condition not helped by the fact that she lives above a funeral parlour where her father Harry works as a mortician. When Harry employs Shelly to help in the mortuary, Vada is concerned that her father and Shelly will become involved. So, along with her best friend Thomas J, she sets out to spy on the couple.

programme.title: Stand By Me
programme.desc: Coming-of-age drama, based on a story by Stephen King, starring Wil Wheaton and River Phoenix. A writer looks back on his childhood in late-1950s Oregon, in particular the time when he and his friends set out to find the corpse of a boy believed to have been hit by a train.

programme.title: Wuthering Heights
programme.desc: Catherine Earnshaw is raised by her alcoholic father at a Yorkshire farmhouse, with Nelly Dean as a constant companion. Mr Earnshaw 'acquires' an orphaned boy named Heathcliff during one of his gallivants and gifts the waif to Cathy as her pet. The children become inseparable, and as adults they embark on a destructive relationship. Writer-director Emerald Fennell's drama based on Emily Bronte's romance, starring Margot Robbie, Jacob Elordi and Martin Clunes

programme.title: Bohemian Rhapsody
programme.desc: Biographical music drama starring Rami Malek. London, 1970: living with his parents, Farrokh Bulsara dreams of becoming a rock star. So when local group Smile loses its lead singer, he convinces guitarist Brian May and drummer Roger Taylor to give him a shot. With the addition of bassist John Deacon and Bulsara changing his name to Freddie Mercury, the band Queen is born - but the path to world domination is a bumpy one.

programme.title: Erin Brockovich
programme.desc: Oscar-winning biographical drama starring Julia Roberts. When she loses a lawsuit following a car accident, unemployed single mother Erin Brockovich browbeats her lawyer, Ed Masry, into giving her a job. Soon she discovers that a power company has been dumping toxic waste and poisoning the residents of a small town. Masry's firm takes up the case - making Brockovich the unlikely linchpin in one of corporate America's biggest ever lawsuits.

programme.title: The Post
programme.desc: Political thriller based on a true story, starring Meryl Streep and Tom Hanks. Kay Graham, publisher of The Washington Post, and editor Ben Bradlee must overcome their differences to bring the leaked Pentagon Papers - which reveal the extent of the US government's involvement in the Vietnam War - into the public eye.

programme.title: Valentine's Day
programme.desc: Romantic comedy featuring an ensemble cast including Anne Hathaway, Jessica Alba and Julia Roberts. The love life of a florist working on Valentine's Day is sent into a tailspin after he proposes to his girlfriend. Meanwhile, his best friend thinks she has met the man of her dreams, little realising he is already married. Will love lend a hand and save the day?

programme.title: Stuart Little
programme.desc: Part-animated fantasy adventure based on EB White's children's story, starring Hugh Laurie and Geena Davis, and featuring the voice of Michael J Fox. The Littles want to adopt a younger brother for their son, George. At the orphanage they are charmed by a young mouse called Stuart, and decide to take him home. While George is stunned by his new companion, the family cat, Snowbell, is delighted.

programme.title: Stuart Little 2
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure based on the characters created by EB White, starring Geena Davis and Hugh Laurie, and featuring the voice of Michael J Fox as the lovable talking mouse. Stuart loses his heart to a little bird called Margalo when he nurses her back to health following an encounter with a vicious falcon. But his new-found love hides a dark secret.

programme.title: Journey 2: The Mysterious Island
programme.desc: Action adventure starring Dwayne Johnson, Michael Caine and Josh Hutcherson. A teenage adventurer locates an island inhabited by monster lizards, giant bees and a gold volcano.

programme.title: Wonder Park
programme.desc: Animated fantasy adventure featuring the voices of Brianna Denski, Jennifer Garner and Mila Kunis. June and her mother while away the hours playing with stuffed animals and imagining a fabulous theme park called "Wonderland". But when Mom is taken to hospital, June runs off into the woods and discovers the Wonderland characters living out a gloomy existence there. Can June make everything right again?

programme.title: A Dog's Purpose
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure starring Britt Robertson and Dennis Quaid, and featuring the voice of Josh Gad. Young Ethan is devastated when his dog and best friend Bailey dies. But Bailey knows that it's not only cats that have nine lives.

programme.title: The SpongeBob Movie: Sponge Out of Water
programme.desc: Part-animated comedy adventure. When the secret formula for the addictive Krabby Patty is stolen by pirate Burger Beard, Mr Krabs seconds SpongeBob to head into the live-action world and get it back. But will the dastardly pirate give it up without a fight?

programme.title: Shaun the Sheep Movie
programme.desc: Animated comedy adventure from Aardman. Shaun's plan to have a lazy day on Mossy Bottom Farm backfires when a cunning ruse sees the Farmer end up lost in the Big City. Shaun and the flock set off to find him, but to succeed they will have to avoid capture by an eager animal control officer, with nothing but elaborate disguises and quick wits.

programme.title: A Shaun the Sheep Movie: Farmageddon
programme.desc: Animated comedy adventure from Aardman, featuring the voices of Justin Fletcher and John Sparkes. Life at Mossy Bottom Farm takes a surprising turn when an alien crash-lands nearby. The extraterrestrial visitor is friendly enough, but when it transpires that a government agent is on its trail, Shaun the Sheep and friends come up with a plan to help the newcomer get back home.

programme.title: Super Charlie
programme.desc: Willie's dream of fighting crime with his cop dad is shattered when his baby brother Charlie arrives. And the new family member turns out to have superpowers. Family animation, with the voices of Karen Ardiff and Alex Kelly

programme.title: Chicken Run
programme.desc: Animated comedy adventure, with the voices of Julia Sawalha, Jane Horrocks, Miranda Richardson and Mel Gibson. A clutch of hens, led by head chick Ginger, suffers life on a grim 1950s egg farm. When the avaricious owners decide to move into the meat-pie business, the chickens fear the worst. With the help of American rooster Rocky, the birds start to plan a prisoner-of-war-style escape.

programme.title: Trolls
programme.desc: Animated musical adventure featuring the voices of Justin Timberlake and Anna Kendrick. The happy land of trolls comes under threat from the Bergens, their miserable, giant neighbours who have developed a taste for trolls. When their kinfolk are kidnapped, bickering trolls Branch and Princess Poppy set out to free them before they're served up for dinner.

programme.title: Smurfs: The Lost Village
programme.desc: Animated adventure featuring the voices of Demi Lovato and Rainn Wilson. Smurfette and friends embark on their biggest ever adventure - travelling beyond the Forbidden Forest in search of other Smurfs.

programme.title: Tafiti - Across the Desert
programme.desc: A young meerkat's grandpa is bitten by a snake, so he sets off to find a magical flower for the cure. Animated adventure, featuring the voices of Cosima Henman, Steve Hudson and Kathleen Renish

programme.title: Dog Man
programme.desc: A half-human canine is sworn to protect and serve as he faces feline supervillain Petey the Cat. Animated comedy, with the voices of Pete Davidson, Poppy Liu, Lil Rel Howery and Isla Fisher

programme.title: E.T.: The Extra-Terrestrial
programme.desc: Steven Spielberg's classic sci-fi adventure, starring Henry Thomas and Dee Wallace, and featuring Drew Barrymore. Ten-year-old Elliott has a new friend, but he's from another planet and nobody must know he's here.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Comedy horror based on the classic TV series, starring Anjelica Huston, Raul Julia and Christopher Lloyd. The ghoulish but happy Addams family are tricked out of their fortune when an impostor claims he's their long-lost Uncle Fester.

programme.title: Christmas Overtime
programme.desc: A workaholic ad executive hires a charming actress to help him convince his team to finish a project on Christmas Eve but soon finds himself falling for her. Romantic comedy, starring Meghan Carrasquillo

programme.title: Pet Sematary
programme.desc: Supernatural horror based on Stephen King's novel, starring Jason Clarke, Amy Seimetz and John Lithgow. Shortly after the Creed family move to a new town, their cat is killed in a traffic accident. Neighbour Jud suggests they lay the animal to rest in an ancient woodland burial ground. When the family is rocked by tragedy, though, events take a macabre turn.

programme.title: Event Horizon
programme.desc: A deep-space salvage crew investigate mysterious events aboard a hi-tech spaceship, which suddenly reappeared in orbit around Neptune after going missing for seven years - but it is not long before they are exposed to terror beyond their wildest nightmares. programme.title: Presence
programme.desc: Supernatural drama starring Lucy Liu, Callina Liang and Chris Sullivan. A mute ghost watches on as a family moves into a spacious suburban home and hidden tensions rise to the surface. Mother Rebekah seems to be involved in a crime, while teenage daughter Chloe, who is grieving after a friend's fatal overdose, begins to sense the unseen presence when it intervenes in the family's life.

programme.title: Assassin's Creed
programme.desc: Sci-fi action adventure starring Michael Fassbender and Marion Cotillard. An Assassin descendant must explore his genetic memories to end the ancient war between his clan and the Templars. Travelling back in time to 15th-century Spain, he gathers the skills and powers he needs to defeat his enemies in the present day.

programme.title: Mad Max
programme.desc: Action adventure starring Mel Gibson. In Australia in the near future, urban society is in terminal decay. Spurred on by tragedy, policeman Max Rockatansky decides to enforce a new kind of law - that of cold-blooded revenge.

programme.title: Green Lantern
programme.desc: Fantasy adventure based on the comic book series, starring Ryan Reynolds. Cocky test pilot Hal Jordan is inducted into an intergalactic peacekeeping force when he inherits a ring from an alien race that endows him with superpowers.

programme.title: Anaconda
programme.desc: Horror adventure starring Jennifer Lopez, Ice Cube and Jon Voight. In the Amazon jungle, a documentary crew rescues a loner who turns out to be a man obsessed. Life becomes dangerous for them all as he attempts to capture a lethal 40ft anaconda...

programme.title: The Shining
programme.desc: Stanley Kubrick's chilling horror, starring Jack Nicholson and Shelley Duvall. Aspiring writer and recovering alcoholic Jack Torrance takes on the job of winter caretaker at the remote Overlook Hotel, despite a warning about the psychological strain the long months of isolation can cause. Jack's wife Wendy only hopes that Jack will finally find the time to write, but his psychically gifted son Danny has visions of a terrifying ordeal for the family.

programme.title: Star Trek Into Darkness
programme.desc: Sci-fi adventure starring Chris Pine, Zachary Quinto and Benedict Cumberbatch. Captain Kirk's disdain for protocol sees him stripped of the command of the Enterprise, but he is given a chance to prove himself after volunteering to find and stop a mysterious operative who's out to destroy Starfleet.

programme.title: Oblivion
programme.desc: Sci-fi action adventure starring Tom Cruise. In the year 2077, Jack Harper works as a drone repairman on an Earth left abandoned and devastated after a war with aliens. With only a few weeks before his mission is due to end, Jack's concept of reality comes crashing down after he rescues a stranger from a downed spacecraft.

programme.title: Gattaca
programme.desc: Science-fiction thriller starring Ethan Hawke, Uma Thurman and Jude Law. Vincent is an outsider, meaning that his birth was natural, making him "In-valid". The world in which he lives is ruled by "designer people" - that is, people forged in test tubes. He is only able to pursue his goal of a mission to space by buying prime genetic material from a "Valid" and forge a new identity. Then he meets Irene, another "Valid", but a week before his flight a Gattaca mission director is brutally murdered.

programme.title: The Bourne Legacy
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Jeremy Renner, Rachel Weisz and Edward Norton. As the CIA's covert operations are compromised and details are leaked to the media, intelligence chiefs decide to cut their losses and kill every agent testing their top secret genetic experiment. Agent Aaron Cross manages to escape the onslaught, but must contact the scientist behind Operation Outcome to maintain his enhanced functions and foil his handlers.

programme.title: Jason Bourne
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Matt Damon, Tommy Lee Jones and Alicia Vikander. Now living in self-imposed exile, former agent Jason Bourne is contacted by an old colleague and is soon drawn into an operation to expose CIA dirty tricks. And, as Bourne well knows, nothing is as it seems and no one can be trusted.

programme.title: The Bourne Identity
programme.desc: Spy action thriller based on the novel by Robert Ludlum, starring Matt Damon and Franka Potente. Jason Bourne is rescued from the Mediterranean with bullet wounds in his back and suffering from amnesia. When he regains consciousness, he discovers that the only clue to his identity is a laser device under his skin, which reveals the name of a Zurich bank and the numbers of a Swiss bank account.

But his former employers are also on the trail with instructions to make sure that the meeting never happens.

programme.title: The Bourne Legacy
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Jeremy Renner, Rachel Weisz and Edward Norton. As the CIA's covert operations are compromised and details are leaked to the media, intelligence chiefs decide to cut their losses and kill every agent testing their top secret genetic experiment. Agent Aaron Cross manages to escape the onslaught, but must contact the scientist behind Operation Outcome to maintain his enhanced functions and foil his handlers.

programme.title: Jason Bourne
programme.desc: Action thriller starring Matt Damon, Tommy Lee Jones and Alicia Vikander. Now living in self-imposed exile, former agent Jason Bourne is contacted by an old colleague and is soon drawn into an operation to expose CIA dirty tricks. And, as Bourne well knows, nothing is as it seems and no one can be trusted.

programme.title: The Bourne Identity
programme.desc: Spy action thriller based on the novel by Robert Ludlum, starring Matt Damon and Franka Potente. Jason Bourne is rescued from the Mediterranean with bullet wounds in his back and suffering from amnesia. When he regains consciousness, he discovers that the only clue to his identity is a laser device under his skin, which reveals the name of a Zurich bank and the numbers of a Swiss bank account.

programme.title: The Bourne Supremacy
programme.desc: Spy action thriller, the first sequel to The Bourne Identity, starring Matt Damon. Ex-CIA agent Jason Bourne, still suffering memory loss following an accident, finds his life in danger when he is implicated in the killing of an agent in Berlin.

programme.title: The Bourne Ultimatum
programme.desc: Spy action thriller, starring Matt Damon, Julia Stiles and Joan Allen. When an article about a covert CIA operation appears in The Guardian, trained assassin Jason Bourne sets off for London to meet the journalist behind the exposé who may be able to shed light on Bourne's past. But his former employers are also on the trail with instructions to make sure that the meeting never happens.

programme.title: Nope
programme.desc: Sci-fi horror starring Daniel Kaluuya and Keke Palmer. Siblings OJ and Em Haywood have taken over their late father's California ranch, where they train horses for use in Hollywood productions. After a series of bizarre occurrences around their property, OJ and Em take measures to record and capture the source of the chaos: a monstrous UFO.

programme.title: Baby Ruby
programme.desc: Psychological horror starring Noémie Merlant and Kit Harington. Lifestyle influencer Jo and her husband Spencer are looking forward to the birth of their first child. But soon after baby Ruby arrives, Jo starts to believe that the newborn is angry with her, and she becomes increasingly distrustful of her husband and her neighbours.

programme.title: Sherlock Holmes and the Secret Weapon
programme.desc: Mystery starring Basil Rathbone and Nigel Bruce. When a pioneering bombsight is developed during the Second World War for use against the Nazis, Sherlock Holmes tries to prevent it falling into the hands of his arch rival Professor Moriarty.

programme.title: Arabesque
programme.desc: Spy drama starring Sophia Loren and Gregory Peck. An American professor becomes involved in an espionage plot after being asked to decipher a coded message. He is told that the price he has to pay for cracking the code is his own death. His only hope is to escape, which he does with the beautiful Yasmin in tow, but can he really trust her?

programme.title: Broken Lance
programme.desc: Oscar-winning western starring Spencer Tracy and Robert Wagner. Rancher Matt Devereaux is obsessed with keeping his cattle empire together. But when he leads a raid on a copper mine to stop the pollution of his land, it leads to trouble for his youngest son, Joe.

programme.title: A Room with a View
programme.desc: Period drama based on the novel by EM Forster, starring Maggie Smith, Helena Bonham Carter, Denholm Elliott, Julian Sands and Daniel Day-Lewis. A young Englishwoman's first grand tour of Europe turns into an unexpectedly complicated journey of discovery. Arriving in Florence with her cousin as her chaperone, they take up their rooms at the Pensione Bertolini and begin to meet the other guests.

programme.title: Suffragette
programme.desc: Historical drama starring Carey Mulligan, Helena Bonham Carter and Meryl Streep. London, 1912: women campaigning for the right to vote are forced into increasingly desperate acts as the state continues to brutalise and oppress them. The struggle draws women from all walks of life to the female ranks, from seasoned political activist Emmeline Pankhurst to simple laundry worker Maud Watts.

programme.title: Dawn of the Planet of the Apes
programme.desc: Sci-fi adventure starring Gary Oldman, Jason Clarke and Andy Serkis. With most of the human population wiped out, the world is now ruled by super-intelligent apes. But their chimp leader Caesar finds his loyalties divided when a small band of human survivors strike back.

programme.title: The Nature of Love
programme.desc: Sophia's comfortable life turns upside down the day she meets Sylvain, and she leaves everything for a new, burning passion. Romantic comedy, starring Magalie Lepine Blondeau, Pierre-Yves Cardinal, Francis-William Rheaume and Monia Chokri. In French, with English subtitles

programme.title: Renegades
programme.desc: Navy Seals are tasked with salvaging Nazi gold that's stored in a bank vault at the bottom of a Bosnian lake. Action adventure, starring JK Simmons, Sullivan Stapleton and Charlie Bewley

programme.desc: Action crime thriller starring Jason Statham, Jessica Alba and Tommy Lee Jones. When a retired hitman's new love is kidnapped, the killer is forced out of retirement to perform three successful assassinations to get her back.

programme.title: Apocalypse of Ice
programme.desc: Disaster movie starring Tom Sizemore. A pandemic-beleaguered world is hit by a vast storm that threatens to leave the Earth almost entirely encrusted in ice. Having found a cure for the virus, a virologist has just 24 hours to reach the safe zone.

programme.desc:
Stop-motion preschool programme about the adventures of four inquisitive Twirlywoos. The Twirlywoos are at a gym hall where they watch a gymnast practising a routine on a balance beam. When the gymnast leaves, Toodloo is eager to try it out and leaps up on the beam, performing a gymnastic routine. Chickedy and Chick also try to balance on the beam - they run along it really fast, holding hands to steady themselves. Next it's Great Big Hoo, who finds it difficult and wobbles around, nearly falling off a few times. The others are at the end of the beam encouraging Great Big Hoo along it. Suddenly the gymnast comes back and so Great Big Hoo makes a run for it, getting all the way to the end of the beam and knocking into the others! They fall into the basin of chalk dust that the gymnasts use to help their grip, and as the hooter sounds, they fly away, creating a big cloud of chalk which surprises the gymnast as she comes back into the room.
Back in the boat, a big wave washes Peekaboo and a collection of pebbles out of the hole in the wall and they are scattered all across the boat floor. The Twirlywoos return, but Peekaboo doesn't have enough time to get back into the hole so hides in amongst the pebbles. When the Twirlywoos drop into the boat they land on the pebbles, where they struggle to keep their balance. Chickedy and Chick jump from pebble to pebble like stepping stones, until they unwittingly land on top of Peekaboo's shell. Peekaboo runs off with Chickedy and Chick balancing on top! They career around the boat crashing into the other pebbles, and into Great Big Hoo and Toodloo, ending up with everyone balanced precariously on top of Peekaboo!
